ko.title: 이번 주 소매 판매 보고서: 국채 금리 상승 속에서 미국 소비자는 여전히 지갑을 열고 있는가?

segments.src: This week's September retail sales report is one of the most closely watched economic releases of the fall.
segments.tr: 이번 주에 발표되는 9월 소매 판매 보고서는 올가을 가장 주목받는 경제 지표 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: It offers a direct read on whether American households kept spending in stores, online and at restaurants even as borrowing costs stayed elevated and prices remained stubborn.
segments.tr: 이 보고서는 차입 비용이 여전히 높고 물가가 좀처럼 잡히지 않는 상황에서도 미국 가계가 매장, 온라인, 식당에서 지출을 유지했는지 직접적으로 보여줍니다.

segments.src: With the holiday quarter approaching, the numbers will shape how analysts, retailers and policymakers think about the strength of the consumer.
segments.tr: 연말 쇼핑 시즌인 4분기가 다가옴에 따라, 이 수치는 분석가, 소매업체, 정책 입안자들이 소비자의 건전성을 어떻게 판단할지 결정하는 기준이 될 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Why This Report Matters
segments.tr: ## 이 보고서가 중요한 이유

segments.src: Consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: 소비 지출은 미국 경제 활동의 약 3분의 2를 차지하며, 이것이 바로 매월 발표되는 소매 판매 보고서에 많은 관심이 쏠리는 이유입니다.

segments.src: economic activity, which is why the monthly retail sales release draws so much attention.
segments.tr: 인구조사국(Census Bureau)에서 집계하는 이 보고서는 다음과 같은 다양한 업종의 매출을 추적합니다.

segments.src: The report, compiled by the Census Bureau, tracks sales at a broad range of businesses, including:
segments.tr: - 식료품점 및 일반 잡화 소매점

segments.src: - Grocery stores and general merchandise retailers
segments.tr: - 자동차 딜러 및 주유소

segments.src: - Auto dealers and gasoline stations
segments.tr: - 온라인 및 기타 무점포 소매업체

segments.src: - Online and other nonstore retailers
segments.tr: - 식당 및 바

segments.src: - Restaurants and bars
segments.tr: - 가구, 전자제품 및 의류 매장

segments.src: - Furniture, electronics and clothing stores
segments.tr: 이 보고서는 매우 광범위한 범주를 다루기 때문에 종종 전체 경제 상황을 미리 보여주는 신호 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: Because it covers so many categories, the report often serves as an early signal for the broader economy.
segments.tr: 수치가 견고하게 나오면 가계가 여전히 지출할 여력과 의지가 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: A solid reading suggests households still have the capacity and willingness to spend.
segments.tr: 반면 수치가 낮게 나오면 높은 비용 부담이 소비에 타격을 주기 시작했는지에 대한 의문이 제기될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A weak one can raise questions about whether higher costs are starting to bite.
segments.tr: ## 배경: 금리 상승과 지속되는 물가 압력

segments.src: ## The Backdrop: Higher Yields and Persistent Prices
segments.tr: 이번 달 경제 상황의 핵심에는 두 가지 요인이 있습니다.

segments.src: Two forces are central to this month's story.
segments.tr: 첫째, 장기 국채 금리가 상승하면서 소비자가 직면하는 주택 담보 대출, 자동차 대출, 신용카드 금리가 오르는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: First, longer-term Treasury yields have climbed, which tends to push up the interest rates consumers face on mortgages, auto loans and credit cards.
segments.tr: 차입 비용이 높아지면 고가 제품 구매를 꺼리게 되고, 대출 잔액을 유지하는 데 드는 비용도 커질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Higher borrowing costs can discourage big-ticket purchases and make carrying a balance more expensive.
segments.tr: 둘째, 물가 압력이 완전히 사라지지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Second, price pressures have not fully faded.
segments.tr: 헤드라인 인플레이션이 둔화되더라도 많은 가계는 여전히 식료품, 주거비, 보험과 같은 필수재 가격 상승의 누적된 영향을 체감하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Even when headline inflation cools, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher prices on essentials such as food, housing and insurance.
segments.tr: 이는 가계 예산에서 재량적 지출을 위한 여유를 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That can leave less room in the budget for discretionary items.
segments.tr: 이러한 압력들이 복합적으로 작용하여 9월 데이터는 소비 회복력을 시험하는 유용한 척도가 됩니다.

segments.src: Together, these pressures make the September data a useful test of resilience.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년간 소비자는 예측가들을 계속 놀라게 했지만, 분석가들은 이러한 흐름이 얼마나 지속될지 계속 의문을 제기하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Shoppers have repeatedly surprised forecasters in recent years, but analysts continue to ask how long that can last.
segments.tr: ## 분석가들이 주목할 점

segments.src: ## What Analysts Will Be Watching
segments.tr: 많은 경제학자들은 단순히 헤드라인 수치에만 집중하기보다 발표 내용의 여러 세부 사항을 살펴볼 것입니다.

segments.src: Rather than focusing only on the top-line figure, many economists will look at several details in the release.
segments.tr: ### 1. 헤드라인 수치 대 "통제 그룹(control group)"

segments.src: ### 1. The headline versus the "control group"
segments.tr: 헤드라인 수치에는 자동차나 휘발유처럼 변동성이 큰 항목이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: The headline number includes volatile categories such as autos and gasoline.
segments.tr: 이른바 '통제 그룹'은 이러한 항목들을 제외한 것으로, GDP 계산 시 소비 지출 추정치를 산출하는 데 주로 사용됩니다.

segments.src: The so-called control group strips out several of these components and is commonly used as an input for estimates of consumer spending in GDP calculations.
segments.tr: 두 수치 사이의 격차는 보고서에 대한 해석을 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A gap between the two can change the interpretation of the report.
segments.tr: ### 2. 명목 지출 대 실질 지출

segments.src: ### 2. Nominal versus real spending
segments.tr: 소매 판매는 명목 달러 기준으로 보고되므로 물가 변동이 반영되지 않습니다.

segments.src: Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars, so they are not adjusted for price changes.
segments.tr: 물가가 상승했다면, 소매 판매가 소폭 증가했더라도 이는 실제 구매량이 늘어난 것이 아니라 가격 상승을 반영한 것일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If prices rose, a modest increase in sales could reflect higher prices rather than more goods purchased.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 종종 데이터를 인플레이션 지표와 비교하여 실제 구매 물량을 추정합니다.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the data with inflation measures to estimate underlying volume.
segments.tr: ### 3. 외식 및 서비스 관련 지출

segments.src: ### 3. Restaurants and services-related spending
segments.tr: 외식은 종종 재량적 소비 심리를 보여주는 바로미터로 간주됩니다.

segments.src: Dining out is often viewed as a barometer of discretionary confidence.
segments.tr: 식당 매출이 부진하면 가계가 더 선택적으로 소비하고 있음을 시사할 수 있고, 반대로 매출이 강세를 보이면 소비자가 여전히 경험을 중시하고 있다는 신호일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Softness at restaurants can suggest households are becoming more selective, while strength can signal that consumers are still prioritizing experiences.
segments.tr: ### 4. 온라인 대 오프라인 매장 트렌드

segments.src: ### 4. Online versus in-store trends
segments.tr: 무점포 소매업체는 시간이 지남에 따라 꾸준히 점유율을 높여왔습니다.

segments.src: Nonstore retailers have steadily gained share over time.
segments.tr: 9월 실적은 프로모션 이벤트 시기나 조기 연말 쇼핑 캠페인의 영향을 반영할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Their September performance may also reflect the timing of promotional events and early holiday shopping campaigns.
segments.tr: ### 5. 이전 달 수치 수정

segments.src: ### 5. Revisions to prior months
segments.tr: 이전 달의 수치는 종종 수정되며, 때로는 의미 있는 수준으로 조정되기도 합니다.

segments.src: Previous months' figures are often revised, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: 수정치는 새로운 월간 수치만큼이나 트렌드에 대한 해석을 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A revision can change the narrative about the trend just as much as the new monthly number does.
segments.tr: ## 가계의 대응 방식

segments.src: ## How Households Are Managing
segments.tr: 압박 속에서도 많은 가계의 지출이 유지된 이유를 설명하는 몇 가지 요인이 있습니다:

segments.src: Several factors help explain why spending has held up for many families, even under pressure:
segments.tr: - **고용:** 비교적 견고한 노동 시장이 소득을 뒷받침했습니다.

segments.src: - **Employment:** A relatively healthy labor market has supported incomes.
segments.tr: - **저축 및 신용:** 일부 가계는 지출을 유지하기 위해 저축을 줄이거나 신용 대출에 더 의존했습니다.

segments.src: - **Savings and credit:** Some households have drawn down savings or relied more on credit to maintain their spending.
segments.tr: - **부의 효과:** 주택 가치와 금융 자산의 상승이 고소득 가계의 지출을 뒷받침했습니다.

segments.src: - **Wealth effects:** Gains in home values and financial assets have supported the spending of higher-income households.
segments.tr: 동시에 상황은 불균형합니다.

segments.src: At the same time, the picture is uneven.
segments.tr: 저소득 및 중산층 가계는 비용 상승과 대출 금리에 더 민감하게 반응하는 경향이 있으며, 더 저렴한 브랜드로 바꾸거나 구매를 미룰 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: Lower- and middle-income households tend to be more sensitive to rising costs and borrowing rates, and they are more likely to trade down to cheaper brands or delay purchases.
segments.tr: 소매업체 경영진들은 가치 중심적인 소비자가 늘고 있다고 점점 더 많이 언급하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Retail executives have increasingly described a more value-conscious shopper.
segments.tr: ## 연말 쇼핑 시즌에 미칠 의미

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for the Holiday Quarter
segments.tr: 연말 4분기는 많은 소매업체에게 가장 중요한 시기이며, 9월 데이터는 종종 그 전조로 읽힙니다.

segments.src: The final three months of the year are the most important period for many retailers, and September data is often read as a preview.
segments.tr: 소매업체는 일반적으로 재고, 인력 배치, 프로모션 결정을 미리 내리기 때문에 최신 매출 동향이 그들의 기대치에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: Retailers typically make inventory, staffing and promotion decisions well in advance, so the latest sales trend influences their expectations.
segments.tr: 예상보다 강력한 보고서가 나온다면 소비자가 여전히 지출 의지가 있음을 시사하여 연말 전망을 낙관적으로 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A stronger-than-expected report could suggest that shoppers are still willing to spend, supporting optimistic holiday forecasts.
segments.tr: 반면 부진한 보고서는 소비자가 더 신중해졌음을 나타내며, 이는 더 큰 폭의 할인과 엄격한 재고 관리로 이어질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A softer report might point to more cautious behavior, potentially leading to heavier discounting and tighter inventory management.
segments.tr: 어느 쪽이든 헤드라인 수치 하나보다는 그 이면의 세부 사항이 더 중요할 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: Either way, the details beneath the headline are likely to matter more than a single figure.
segments.tr: ## 정책 및 시장에 미치는 영향

segments.src: ## Policy and Market Implications
segments.tr: 이 보고서는 통화 정책에 관한 더 넓은 논쟁에도 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: The report also feeds into the broader debate over monetary policy.
segments.tr: 강력한 소비자 수요는 인플레이션을 목표치로 완전히 되돌리려는 노력을 복잡하게 만들 수 있는 반면, 뚜렷한 둔화세는 더 완화적인 정책 기조를 뒷받침할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Strong consumer demand can complicate efforts to bring inflation fully back to target, while a clear slowdown may strengthen the case for a more accommodative stance.
segments.tr: 금융 시장은 특히 국채 금리와 소비재 관련 기업의 주가 등에서 발표 직후 빠르게 반응하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Financial markets often react quickly to the release, particularly in Treasury yields and in shares of consumer-focused companies.
segments.tr: 한 달 치 데이터는 노이즈가 많을 수 있다는 점을 기억해야 합니다.

segments.src: It is worth remembering that a single month of data can be noisy.
segments.tr: 날씨, 일회성 이벤트, 계절 조정 문제 등이 전체적인 상황을 왜곡할 수 있으므로 경제학자들은 일반적으로 수개월에 걸친 추세를 살펴보는 것을 선호합니다.

segments.src: Weather, one-off events and seasonal adjustment issues can all distort the picture, so economists generally prefer to look at multi-month trends.
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: 9월 소매 판매 보고서가 미국 소비자의 건전성에 대한 모든 의문을 해결해주지는 않겠지만, 중요한 시점에 중요한 데이터 포인트를 제공할 것입니다.

segments.src: The September retail sales report will not settle every question about the health of the American consumer, but it will provide an important data point at a pivotal moment.
segments.tr: 핵심 질문은 가계가 여전히 폭넓고 여유 있게 지출하고 있는지, 아니면 높은 차입 비용과 지속되는 물가 압력으로 인해 더 많은 타협을 강요받고 있는지입니다.

segments.src: The key question is whether households are still spending broadly and comfortably, or whether higher borrowing costs and lingering price pressures are forcing more trade-offs.
segments.tr: 경제를 팔로우하는 독자들에게 가장 유용한 접근 방식은 통제 그룹을 주시하고, 지출을 인플레이션과 비교하며, 고용 및 소득 추세와 함께 데이터를 고려하는 것입니다.

segments.src: For readers following the economy, the most useful approach is to watch the control group, compare spending with inflation and consider the data alongside employment and income trends.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로만 작성되었으며 투자, 재무 또는 법률 자문을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute investment, financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: 경제 데이터는 수정될 수 있으며 실제 결과는 예상과 다를 수 있습니다.*

segments.src: Economic data are subject to revision, and actual results may differ from expectations.*
segments.tr: 경제 데이터는 수정될 수 있으며, 실제 결과는 예상과 다를 수 있습니다.*

segments.src: ## The Backdrop: Higher Yields and Persistent Prices

segments.src: Two forces are central to this month's story.
segments.tr: 有两种力量是本月故事的核心。

segments.src: First, longer-term Treasury yields have climbed, which tends to push up the interest rates consumers face on mortgages, auto loans and credit cards.
segments.tr: 首先，较长期国债收益率已经攀升，这往往会推高消费者在抵押贷款、汽车贷款和信用卡上面临的利率水平。

segments.src: Higher borrowing costs can discourage big-ticket purchases and make carrying a balance more expensive.
segments.tr: 更高的借贷成本可能会抑制大宗购买，并使维持透支余额的成本更高。

segments.src: Second, price pressures have not fully faded.
segments.tr: 其次，价格压力尚未完全消退。

segments.src: Even when headline inflation cools, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher prices on essentials such as food, housing and insurance.
segments.tr: 即便整体通胀有所降温，许多家庭仍然感受到食品、住房和保险等必需品价格上涨的累积效应。

segments.src: That can leave less room in the budget for discretionary items.
segments.tr: 这可能会给预算中用于非必需品的开支留下更少空间。

segments.src: Together, these pressures make the September data a useful test of resilience.
segments.tr: 综合来看，这些压力使9月的数据成为检验韧性的一个有用测试。

segments.src: Shoppers have repeatedly surprised forecasters in recent years, but analysts continue to ask how long that can last.
segments.tr: 近年来，购物者多次令预测者感到惊讶，但分析师们仍在继续追问这种情况能持续多久。

segments.src: ## What Analysts Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## 分析师将关注什么

segments.src: Rather than focusing only on the top-line figure, many economists will look at several details in the release.
segments.tr: 许多经济学家不会只关注整体数字，而是会查看报告中的几个细节。

segments.src: ### 1. The headline versus the "control group"
segments.tr: ### 1. 整体数据与“控制组”的对比

segments.src: The headline number includes volatile categories such as autos and gasoline.
segments.tr: 整体数字包括汽车和汽油等波动较大的类别。

segments.src: The so-called control group strips out several of these components and is commonly used as an input for estimates of consumer spending in GDP calculations.
segments.tr: 所谓的控制组剔除了其中几个组成部分，通常用作GDP计算中消费者支出估计的输入变量。

segments.src: A gap between the two can change the interpretation of the report.
segments.tr: 两者之间的差距可能会改变对报告的解读。

segments.src: ### 2. Nominal versus real spending
segments.tr: ### 2. 名义支出与实际支出的对比

segments.src: Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars, so they are not adjusted for price changes.
segments.tr: 零售销售额以名义美元报告，因此未针对价格变化进行调整。

segments.src: If prices rose, a modest increase in sales could reflect higher prices rather than more goods purchased.
segments.tr: 如果价格上涨，销售额的适度增长可能反映的是价格更高，而不是购买的商品更多。

segments.src: Analysts often compare the data with inflation measures to estimate underlying volume.
segments.tr: 分析师经常将数据与通胀指标进行比较，以估计潜在的销售量。

segments.src: ### 3. Restaurants and services-related spending
segments.tr: ### 3. 餐饮及服务相关支出

segments.src: Dining out is often viewed as a barometer of discretionary confidence.
segments.tr: 外出就餐通常被视为非必需消费信心的一个晴雨表。

segments.src: Softness at restaurants can suggest households are becoming more selective, while strength can signal that consumers are still prioritizing experiences.
segments.tr: 餐厅业务的疲软可能表明家庭正变得更具选择性，而强劲则可能表明消费者仍在优先考虑体验。

segments.src: ### 4. Online versus in-store trends
segments.tr: ### 4. 网购与实体店趋势

segments.src: Nonstore retailers have steadily gained share over time.
segments.tr: 无店铺零售商的市场份额随着时间推移稳步增长。

segments.src: Their September performance may also reflect the timing of promotional events and early holiday shopping campaigns.
segments.tr: 它们在9月份的表现也可能反映了促销活动的时间安排和早期的假日购物活动。

segments.src: ### 5. Revisions to prior months
segments.tr: ### 5. 对前几个月的修正

segments.src: Previous months' figures are often revised, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: 前几个月的数据经常会被修正，有时甚至是意义重大的修正。

segments.src: A revision can change the narrative about the trend just as much as the new monthly number does.
segments.tr: 修正可能会像新的月度数字一样，改变对趋势的叙述。

segments.src: ## How Households Are Managing
segments.tr: ## 家庭如何应对

segments.src: Several factors help explain why spending has held up for many families, even under pressure:
segments.tr: 有几个因素有助于解释为什么许多家庭的支出在压力下依然坚挺：

segments.src: - **Employment:** A relatively healthy labor market has supported incomes.
segments.tr: - **就业：** 相对健康的劳动力市场为收入提供了支撑。

segments.src: - **Savings and credit:** Some households have drawn down savings or relied more on credit to maintain their spending.
segments.tr: - **储蓄与信贷：** 一些家庭动用了储蓄或更多地依赖信贷来维持支出。

segments.src: - **Wealth effects:** Gains in home values and financial assets have supported the spending of higher-income households.
segments.tr: - **财富效应：** 房价和金融资产的上涨支撑了高收入家庭的支出。

segments.src: At the same time, the picture is uneven.
segments.tr: 与此同时，情况并不均衡。

segments.src: Lower- and middle-income households tend to be more sensitive to rising costs and borrowing rates, and they are more likely to trade down to cheaper brands or delay purchases.
segments.tr: 中低收入家庭往往对不断上升的成本和借贷利率更为敏感，他们更有可能转向更便宜的品牌或推迟购买。

segments.src: Retail executives have increasingly described a more value-conscious shopper.
segments.tr: 零售高管们越来越多地描述出一个更具价值意识的购物者群体。

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for the Holiday Quarter
segments.tr: ## 这对假日季度意味着什么

segments.src: The final three months of the year are the most important period for many retailers, and September data is often read as a preview.
segments.tr: 一年的最后三个月对许多零售商来说是最重要的时期，而9月的数据通常被解读为预演。

segments.src: Retailers typically make inventory, staffing and promotion decisions well in advance, so the latest sales trend influences their expectations.
segments.tr: 零售商通常会提前很久做出库存、人员配备和促销决策，因此最新的销售趋势会影响他们的预期。

segments.src: A stronger-than-expected report could suggest that shoppers are still willing to spend, supporting optimistic holiday forecasts.
segments.tr: 一份强于预期的报告可能表明购物者仍然愿意消费，从而支持乐观的假日预测。

segments.src: A softer report might point to more cautious behavior, potentially leading to heavier discounting and tighter inventory management.
segments.tr: 一份较为疲软的报告可能指向更加谨慎的行为，从而可能导致更大幅度的折扣和更紧缩的库存管理。

segments.src: Either way, the details beneath the headline are likely to matter more than a single figure.
segments.tr: 无论哪种方式，头条数字背后的细节可能比单一数据更重要。

segments.src: ## Policy and Market Implications
segments.tr: ## 政策与市场影响

segments.src: The report also feeds into the broader debate over monetary policy.
segments.tr: 该报告也构成了关于货币政策的更广泛争论的一部分。

segments.src: Strong consumer demand can complicate efforts to bring inflation fully back to target, while a clear slowdown may strengthen the case for a more accommodative stance.
segments.tr: 强劲的消费者需求可能会使将通胀完全拉回目标的努力变得复杂，而明显的放缓则可能会强化采取更宽松立场的理由。

segments.src: Financial markets often react quickly to the release, particularly in Treasury yields and in shares of consumer-focused companies.
segments.tr: 金融市场通常对该数据的发布做出快速反应，特别是在国债收益率和消费者导向型公司的股票方面。

segments.src: It is worth remembering that a single month of data can be noisy.
segments.tr: 值得记住的是，单月数据可能存在噪音。

segments.src: Weather, one-off events and seasonal adjustment issues can all distort the picture, so economists generally prefer to look at multi-month trends.
segments.tr: 天气、一次性事件和季节性调整问题都可能扭曲整体情况，因此经济学家通常更倾向于观察多月趋势。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The September retail sales report will not settle every question about the health of the American consumer, but it will provide an important data point at a pivotal moment.
segments.tr: 9月份的零售销售报告不会解决关于美国消费者健康状况的所有问题，但它将在一个关键时刻提供一个重要的数据点。

segments.src: The key question is whether households are still spending broadly and comfortably, or whether higher borrowing costs and lingering price pressures are forcing more trade-offs.
segments.tr: 关键问题是家庭是否仍在广泛而舒适地消费，还是更高的借贷成本和挥之不去的价格压力正在迫使他们做出更多权衡。

segments.src: For readers following the economy, the most useful approach is to watch the control group, compare spending with inflation and consider the data alongside employment and income trends.
segments.tr: 对于关注经济的读者来说，最有效的方法是观察控制组，将支出与通胀进行比较，并将数据与就业和收入趋势结合起来考虑。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，不构成投资、财务或法律建议。

segments.src: Economic data are subject to revision, and actual results may differ from expectations.*
segments.tr: 经济数据可能会有所修正，实际结果可能与预期有所不同。*

hi.title: इस सप्ताह की खुदरा बिक्री रिपोर्ट: क्या यील्ड बढ़ने के बावजूद अमेरिकी खरीदार खर्च कर रहे हैं?

segments.src: This week's September retail sales report is one of the most closely watched economic releases of the fall.
segments.tr: इस सप्ताह की सितंबर की खुदरा बिक्री रिपोर्ट शरद ऋतु के सबसे बारीकी से देखे जाने वाले आर्थिक आंकड़ों में से एक है।

segments.src: It offers a direct read on whether American households kept spending in stores, online and at restaurants even as borrowing costs stayed elevated and prices remained stubborn.
segments.tr: यह इस बात का सीधा संकेत देती है कि क्या अमेरिकी परिवारों ने दुकानों, ऑनलाइन और रेस्तरां में खर्च करना जारी रखा है, भले ही उधार लेने की लागत अधिक बनी हुई है और कीमतें स्थिर हैं।

segments.src: With the holiday quarter approaching, the numbers will shape how analysts, retailers and policymakers think about the strength of the consumer.
segments.tr: छुट्टियों की तिमाही नजदीक आने के साथ, ये आंकड़े यह तय करेंगे कि विश्लेषक, खुदरा विक्रेता और नीति निर्माता उपभोक्ता की मजबूती के बारे में क्या सोचते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why This Report Matters
segments.tr: ## यह रिपोर्ट क्यों मायने रखती है

segments.src: Consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता खर्च अमेरिकी आर्थिक गतिविधि का लगभग दो-तिहाई हिस्सा है,

segments.src: economic activity, which is why the monthly retail sales release draws so much attention.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि मासिक खुदरा बिक्री रिपोर्ट पर इतना ध्यान दिया जाता है।

segments.src: The report, compiled by the Census Bureau, tracks sales at a broad range of businesses, including:
segments.tr: जनगणना ब्यूरो द्वारा संकलित यह रिपोर्ट व्यवसायों की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला में बिक्री को ट्रैक करती है, जिसमें शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - Grocery stores and general merchandise retailers
segments.tr: - किराना स्टोर और सामान्य मर्चेंडाइज खुदरा विक्रेता

segments.src: - Auto dealers and gasoline stations
segments.tr: - ऑटो डीलर और गैस स्टेशन

segments.src: - Online and other nonstore retailers
segments.tr: - ऑनलाइन और अन्य गैर-स्टोर खुदरा विक्रेता

segments.src: - Restaurants and bars
segments.tr: - रेस्तरां और बार

segments.src: - Furniture, electronics and clothing stores
segments.tr: - फर्नीचर, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स और कपड़ों के स्टोर

segments.src: Because it covers so many categories, the report often serves as an early signal for the broader economy.
segments.tr: चूंकि यह बहुत सारी श्रेणियों को कवर करती है, इसलिए यह रिपोर्ट अक्सर व्यापक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए एक शुरुआती संकेत के रूप में कार्य करती है।

segments.src: A solid reading suggests households still have the capacity and willingness to spend.
segments.tr: एक ठोस रीडिंग बताती है कि परिवारों के पास अभी भी खर्च करने की क्षमता और इच्छा है।

segments.src: A weak one can raise questions about whether higher costs are starting to bite.
segments.tr: एक कमजोर रीडिंग इस बारे में सवाल उठा सकती है कि क्या उच्च लागत का असर दिखना शुरू हो गया है।

segments.src: ## The Backdrop: Higher Yields and Persistent Prices
segments.tr: ## पृष्ठभूमि: उच्च यील्ड और लगातार बनी हुई कीमतें

segments.src: Two forces are central to this month's story.
segments.tr: इस महीने की कहानी के केंद्र में दो ताकतें हैं।

segments.src: First, longer-term Treasury yields have climbed, which tends to push up the interest rates consumers face on mortgages, auto loans and credit cards.
segments.tr: पहला, लंबी अवधि की ट्रेजरी यील्ड बढ़ गई है, जो आमतौर पर बंधक (मॉर्गेज), ऑटो ऋण और क्रेडिट कार्ड पर उपभोक्ताओं द्वारा सामना की जाने वाली ब्याज दरों को बढ़ा देती है।

segments.src: Higher borrowing costs can discourage big-ticket purchases and make carrying a balance more expensive.
segments.tr: उधार लेने की उच्च लागत बड़ी खरीदारी को हतोत्साहित कर सकती है और बैलेंस बनाए रखना अधिक महंगा बना सकती है।

segments.src: Second, price pressures have not fully faded.
segments.tr: दूसरा, मूल्य का दबाव पूरी तरह से कम नहीं हुआ है।

segments.src: Even when headline inflation cools, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher prices on essentials such as food, housing and insurance.
segments.tr: भले ही हेडलाइन मुद्रास्फीति ठंडी हो जाए, कई परिवार अभी भी भोजन, आवास और बीमा जैसी आवश्यक वस्तुओं पर उच्च कीमतों के संचयी प्रभाव को महसूस करते हैं।

segments.src: That can leave less room in the budget for discretionary items.
segments.tr: यह बजट में विवेकाधीन वस्तुओं के लिए कम जगह छोड़ सकता है।

segments.src: Together, these pressures make the September data a useful test of resilience.
segments.tr: कुल मिलाकर, ये दबाव सितंबर के आंकड़ों को लचीलेपन का एक उपयोगी परीक्षण बनाते हैं।

segments.src: Shoppers have repeatedly surprised forecasters in recent years, but analysts continue to ask how long that can last.
segments.tr: खरीदारों ने हाल के वर्षों में पूर्वानुमानकर्ताओं को बार-बार आश्चर्यचकित किया है, लेकिन विश्लेषक लगातार पूछ रहे हैं कि यह कब तक चल सकता है।

segments.src: ## What Analysts Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## विश्लेषक क्या देखेंगे

segments.src: Rather than focusing only on the top-line figure, many economists will look at several details in the release.
segments.tr: केवल मुख्य आंकड़े पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने के बजाय, कई अर्थशास्त्री रिपोर्ट में कई विवरणों को देखेंगे।

segments.src: ### 1. The headline versus the "control group"
segments.tr: ### 1. हेडलाइन बनाम "कंट्रोल ग्रुप"

segments.src: The headline number includes volatile categories such as autos and gasoline.
segments.tr: हेडलाइन संख्या में ऑटो और गैसोलीन जैसी अस्थिर श्रेणियां शामिल हैं।

segments.src: The so-called control group strips out several of these components and is commonly used as an input for estimates of consumer spending in GDP calculations.
segments.tr: तथाकथित कंट्रोल ग्रुप इनमें से कई घटकों को हटा देता है और आमतौर पर जीडीपी गणना में उपभोक्ता खर्च के अनुमानों के लिए एक इनपुट के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है।

segments.src: A gap between the two can change the interpretation of the report.
segments.tr: दोनों के बीच का अंतर रिपोर्ट की व्याख्या को बदल सकता है।

segments.src: ### 2. Nominal versus real spending
segments.tr: ### 2. नाममात्र बनाम वास्तविक खर्च

segments.src: Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars, so they are not adjusted for price changes.
segments.tr: खुदरा बिक्री नाममात्र डॉलर में रिपोर्ट की जाती है, इसलिए उन्हें मूल्य परिवर्तनों के लिए समायोजित नहीं किया जाता है।

segments.src: If prices rose, a modest increase in sales could reflect higher prices rather than more goods purchased.
segments.tr: यदि कीमतें बढ़ती हैं, तो बिक्री में मामूली वृद्धि अधिक सामान खरीदे जाने के बजाय उच्च कीमतों को दर्शा सकती है।

segments.src: Analysts often compare the data with inflation measures to estimate underlying volume.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक अक्सर अंतर्निहित मात्रा का अनुमान लगाने के लिए डेटा की तुलना मुद्रास्फीति के उपायों से करते हैं।

segments.src: ### 3. Restaurants and services-related spending
segments.tr: ### 3. रेस्तरां और सेवाओं से संबंधित खर्च

segments.src: Dining out is often viewed as a barometer of discretionary confidence.
segments.tr: बाहर खाना अक्सर विवेकाधीन विश्वास के बैरोमीटर के रूप में देखा जाता है।

segments.src: Softness at restaurants can suggest households are becoming more selective, while strength can signal that consumers are still prioritizing experiences.
segments.tr: रेस्तरां में नरमी यह सुझाव दे सकती है कि परिवार अधिक चयनात्मक हो रहे हैं, जबकि मजबूती यह संकेत दे सकती है कि उपभोक्ता अभी भी अनुभवों को प्राथमिकता दे रहे हैं।

segments.src: ### 4. Online versus in-store trends
segments.tr: ### 4. ऑनलाइन बनाम इन-स्टोर रुझान

segments.src: Nonstore retailers have steadily gained share over time.
segments.tr: गैर-स्टोर खुदरा विक्रेताओं ने समय के साथ लगातार हिस्सेदारी हासिल की है।

segments.src: Their September performance may also reflect the timing of promotional events and early holiday shopping campaigns.
segments.tr: उनका सितंबर का प्रदर्शन प्रचार कार्यक्रमों और शुरुआती छुट्टियों की खरीदारी अभियानों के समय को भी प्रतिबिंबित कर सकता है।

segments.src: ### 5. Revisions to prior months
segments.tr: ### 5. पिछले महीनों में संशोधन

segments.src: Previous months' figures are often revised, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: पिछले महीनों के आंकड़ों को अक्सर संशोधित किया जाता है, कभी-कभी सार्थक रूप से।

segments.src: A revision can change the narrative about the trend just as much as the new monthly number does.
segments.tr: एक संशोधन रुझान के बारे में कहानी को उतना ही बदल सकता है जितना कि नई मासिक संख्या करती है।

segments.src: ## How Households Are Managing
segments.tr: ## परिवार कैसे प्रबंधन कर रहे हैं

segments.src: Several factors help explain why spending has held up for many families, even under pressure:
segments.tr: कई कारक यह समझाने में मदद करते हैं कि दबाव में होने के बावजूद कई परिवारों के लिए खर्च क्यों बना हुआ है:

segments.src: - **Employment:** A relatively healthy labor market has supported incomes.
segments.tr: - **रोजगार:** अपेक्षाकृत स्वस्थ श्रम बाजार ने आय का समर्थन किया है।

segments.src: - **Savings and credit:** Some households have drawn down savings or relied more on credit to maintain their spending.
segments.tr: - **बचत और क्रेडिट:** कुछ परिवारों ने अपनी बचत का उपयोग किया है या अपने खर्च को बनाए रखने के लिए क्रेडिट पर अधिक भरोसा किया है।

segments.src: - **Wealth effects:** Gains in home values and financial assets have supported the spending of higher-income households.
segments.tr: - **धन प्रभाव:** घर के मूल्यों और वित्तीय संपत्तियों में लाभ ने उच्च आय वाले परिवारों के खर्च का समर्थन किया है।

segments.src: At the same time, the picture is uneven.
segments.tr: साथ ही, तस्वीर असमान है।

segments.src: Lower- and middle-income households tend to be more sensitive to rising costs and borrowing rates, and they are more likely to trade down to cheaper brands or delay purchases.
segments.tr: निम्न और मध्यम आय वाले परिवार बढ़ती लागत और उधार दरों के प्रति अधिक संवेदनशील होते हैं, और उनके सस्ते ब्रांडों की ओर रुख करने या खरीदारी में देरी करने की अधिक संभावना होती है।

segments.src: Retail executives have increasingly described a more value-conscious shopper.
segments.tr: खुदरा अधिकारियों ने तेजी से अधिक मूल्य-सचेत खरीदार का वर्णन किया है।

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for the Holiday Quarter
segments.tr: ## छुट्टियों की तिमाही के लिए इसका क्या मतलब हो सकता है

segments.src: The final three months of the year are the most important period for many retailers, and September data is often read as a preview.
segments.tr: वर्ष के अंतिम तीन महीने कई खुदरा विक्रेताओं के लिए सबसे महत्वपूर्ण अवधि हैं, और सितंबर के आंकड़ों को अक्सर एक पूर्वावलोकन के रूप में पढ़ा जाता है।

segments.src: Retailers typically make inventory, staffing and promotion decisions well in advance, so the latest sales trend influences their expectations.
segments.tr: खुदरा विक्रेता आमतौर पर इन्वेंट्री, स्टाफिंग और प्रचार के निर्णय बहुत पहले ही ले लेते हैं, इसलिए नवीनतम बिक्री का रुझान उनकी अपेक्षाओं को प्रभावित करता है।

segments.src: A stronger-than-expected report could suggest that shoppers are still willing to spend, supporting optimistic holiday forecasts.
segments.tr: उम्मीद से बेहतर रिपोर्ट यह सुझाव दे सकती है कि खरीदार अभी भी खर्च करने के इच्छुक हैं, जो आशावादी छुट्टियों के पूर्वानुमानों का समर्थन करते हैं।

segments.src: A softer report might point to more cautious behavior, potentially leading to heavier discounting and tighter inventory management.
segments.tr: एक नरम रिपोर्ट अधिक सतर्क व्यवहार की ओर इशारा कर सकती है, जो संभावित रूप से भारी छूट और सख्त इन्वेंट्री प्रबंधन की ओर ले जाती है।

segments.src: Either way, the details beneath the headline are likely to matter more than a single figure.
segments.tr: किसी भी तरह, हेडलाइन के नीचे के विवरण एक एकल आंकड़े से अधिक मायने रखने की संभावना है।

segments.src: ## Policy and Market Implications
segments.tr: ## नीति और बाजार के निहितार्थ

segments.src: The report also feeds into the broader debate over monetary policy.
segments.tr: यह रिपोर्ट मौद्रिक नीति पर व्यापक बहस में भी योगदान देती है।

segments.src: Strong consumer demand can complicate efforts to bring inflation fully back to target, while a clear slowdown may strengthen the case for a more accommodative stance.
segments.tr: मजबूत उपभोक्ता मांग मुद्रास्फीति को पूरी तरह से लक्ष्य पर वापस लाने के प्रयासों को जटिल बना सकती है, जबकि स्पष्ट मंदी अधिक उदार रुख के मामले को मजबूत कर सकती है।

segments.src: Financial markets often react quickly to the release, particularly in Treasury yields and in shares of consumer-focused companies.
segments.tr: वित्तीय बाजार अक्सर रिलीज पर जल्दी प्रतिक्रिया करते हैं, विशेष रूप से ट्रेजरी यील्ड और उपभोक्ता-केंद्रित कंपनियों के शेयरों में।

segments.src: It is worth remembering that a single month of data can be noisy.
segments.tr: यह याद रखना उचित है कि डेटा का एक महीना शोर भरा हो सकता है।

segments.src: Weather, one-off events and seasonal adjustment issues can all distort the picture, so economists generally prefer to look at multi-month trends.
segments.tr: मौसम, एक बार की घटनाएं और मौसमी समायोजन के मुद्दे सभी तस्वीर को विकृत कर सकते हैं, इसलिए अर्थशास्त्री आम तौर पर बहु-मासिक रुझानों को देखना पसंद करते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: The September retail sales report will not settle every question about the health of the American consumer, but it will provide an important data point at a pivotal moment.
segments.tr: सितंबर की खुदरा बिक्री रिपोर्ट अमेरिकी उपभोक्ता के स्वास्थ्य के बारे में हर सवाल का समाधान नहीं करेगी, लेकिन यह एक महत्वपूर्ण मोड़ पर एक महत्वपूर्ण डेटा बिंदु प्रदान करेगी।

segments.src: The key question is whether households are still spending broadly and comfortably, or whether higher borrowing costs and lingering price pressures are forcing more trade-offs.
segments.tr: मुख्य प्रश्न यह है कि क्या परिवार अभी भी व्यापक रूप से और आराम से खर्च कर रहे हैं, या क्या उच्च उधार लागत और लंबे समय तक चलने वाले मूल्य दबाव अधिक ट्रेड-ऑफ के लिए मजबूर कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: For readers following the economy, the most useful approach is to watch the control group, compare spending with inflation and consider the data alongside employment and income trends.
segments.tr: अर्थव्यवस्था का अनुसरण करने वाले पाठकों के लिए, सबसे उपयोगी दृष्टिकोण कंट्रोल ग्रुप को देखना, मुद्रास्फीति के साथ खर्च की तुलना करना और रोजगार और आय के रुझानों के साथ डेटा पर विचार करना है।

es.title: Informe de ventas minoristas de esta semana: ¿Sigue gastando el comprador estadounidense a medida que suben los rendimientos?

segments.src: This week's September retail sales report is one of the most closely watched economic releases of the fall.
segments.tr: El informe de ventas minoristas de septiembre de esta semana es uno de los datos económicos más observados del otoño.

segments.src: It offers a direct read on whether American households kept spending in stores, online and at restaurants even as borrowing costs stayed elevated and prices remained stubborn.
segments.tr: Ofrece una lectura directa sobre si los hogares estadounidenses siguieron gastando en tiendas, en línea y en restaurantes, incluso cuando los costos de endeudamiento se mantuvieron elevados y los precios persistieron.

segments.src: With the holiday quarter approaching, the numbers will shape how analysts, retailers and policymakers think about the strength of the consumer.
segments.tr: Con la proximidad del trimestre festivo, las cifras determinarán cómo los analistas, minoristas y responsables de políticas evalúan la fortaleza del consumidor.

segments.src: ## Why This Report Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué es importante este informe

segments.src: Consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: El gasto del consumidor representa aproximadamente dos tercios de la

segments.src: economic activity, which is why the monthly retail sales release draws so much attention.
segments.tr: actividad económica de EE. UU., razón por la cual la publicación mensual de ventas minoristas atrae tanta atención.

segments.src: The report, compiled by the Census Bureau, tracks sales at a broad range of businesses, including:
segments.tr: El informe, compilado por la Oficina del Censo, rastrea las ventas en una amplia gama de negocios, incluyendo:

segments.src: - Grocery stores and general merchandise retailers
segments.tr: - Tiendas de comestibles y minoristas de mercancías generales

segments.src: - Auto dealers and gasoline stations
segments.tr: - Concesionarios de automóviles y gasolineras

segments.src: - Online and other nonstore retailers
segments.tr: - Minoristas en línea y otros minoristas sin tienda física

segments.src: - Restaurants and bars
segments.tr: - Restaurantes y bares

segments.src: - Furniture, electronics and clothing stores
segments.tr: - Tiendas de muebles, electrónica y ropa

segments.src: Because it covers so many categories, the report often serves as an early signal for the broader economy.
segments.tr: Debido a que cubre tantas categorías, el informe a menudo sirve como una señal temprana para la economía en general.

segments.src: A solid reading suggests households still have the capacity and willingness to spend.
segments.tr: Una lectura sólida sugiere que los hogares aún tienen la capacidad y la disposición para gastar.

segments.src: A weak one can raise questions about whether higher costs are starting to bite.
segments.tr: Una lectura débil puede plantear dudas sobre si los costos más altos están empezando a hacer mella.

segments.src: ## The Backdrop: Higher Yields and Persistent Prices
segments.tr: ## El contexto: mayores rendimientos y precios persistentes

segments.src: Two forces are central to this month's story.
segments.tr: Dos fuerzas son fundamentales para la historia de este mes.

segments.src: First, longer-term Treasury yields have climbed, which tends to push up the interest rates consumers face on mortgages, auto loans and credit cards.
segments.tr: En primer lugar, los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a largo plazo han subido, lo que tiende a aumentar las tasas de interés que enfrentan los consumidores en hipotecas, préstamos para automóviles y tarjetas de crédito.

segments.src: Higher borrowing costs can discourage big-ticket purchases and make carrying a balance more expensive.
segments.tr: Los mayores costos de endeudamiento pueden desalentar las compras importantes y hacer que mantener un saldo sea más costoso.

segments.src: Second, price pressures have not fully faded.
segments.tr: En segundo lugar, las presiones sobre los precios no han desaparecido por completo.

segments.src: Even when headline inflation cools, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher prices on essentials such as food, housing and insurance.
segments.tr: Incluso cuando la inflación general se enfría, muchos hogares aún sienten el efecto acumulativo de los precios más altos en artículos esenciales como alimentos, vivienda y seguros.

segments.src: That can leave less room in the budget for discretionary items.
segments.tr: Eso puede dejar menos espacio en el presupuesto para artículos discrecionales.

segments.src: Together, these pressures make the September data a useful test of resilience.
segments.tr: Juntas, estas presiones hacen que los datos de septiembre sean una prueba útil de resiliencia.

segments.src: Shoppers have repeatedly surprised forecasters in recent years, but analysts continue to ask how long that can last.
segments.tr: Los compradores han sorprendido repetidamente a los pronosticadores en los últimos años, pero los analistas siguen preguntándose cuánto tiempo puede durar eso.

segments.src: ## What Analysts Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## Qué observarán los analistas

segments.src: Rather than focusing only on the top-line figure, many economists will look at several details in the release.
segments.tr: En lugar de centrarse solo en la cifra principal, muchos economistas analizarán varios detalles en la publicación.

segments.src: ### 1. The headline versus the "control group"
segments.tr: ### 1. La cifra principal frente al "grupo de control"

segments.src: The headline number includes volatile categories such as autos and gasoline.
segments.tr: La cifra principal incluye categorías volátiles como automóviles y gasolina.

segments.src: The so-called control group strips out several of these components and is commonly used as an input for estimates of consumer spending in GDP calculations.
segments.tr: El llamado grupo de control elimina varios de estos componentes y se utiliza comúnmente como insumo para las estimaciones del gasto del consumidor en los cálculos del PIB.

segments.src: A gap between the two can change the interpretation of the report.
segments.tr: Una brecha entre ambos puede cambiar la interpretación del informe.

segments.src: ### 2. Nominal versus real spending
segments.tr: ### 2. Gasto nominal frente a real

segments.src: Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars, so they are not adjusted for price changes.
segments.tr: Las ventas minoristas se reportan en dólares nominales, por lo que no están ajustadas por cambios en los precios.

segments.src: If prices rose, a modest increase in sales could reflect higher prices rather than more goods purchased.
segments.tr: Si los precios subieron, un aumento modesto en las ventas podría reflejar precios más altos en lugar de más bienes comprados.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the data with inflation measures to estimate underlying volume.
segments.tr: Los analistas a menudo comparan los datos con las medidas de inflación para estimar el volumen subyacente.

segments.src: ### 3. Restaurants and services-related spending
segments.tr: ### 3. Restaurantes y gasto relacionado con servicios

segments.src: Dining out is often viewed as a barometer of discretionary confidence.
segments.tr: Comer fuera a menudo se considera un barómetro de la confianza discrecional.

segments.src: Softness at restaurants can suggest households are becoming more selective, while strength can signal that consumers are still prioritizing experiences.
segments.tr: La debilidad en los restaurantes puede sugerir que los hogares se están volviendo más selectivos, mientras que la fortaleza puede indicar que los consumidores siguen priorizando las experiencias.

segments.src: ### 4. Online versus in-store trends
segments.tr: ### 4. Tendencias en línea frente a tiendas físicas

segments.src: Nonstore retailers have steadily gained share over time.
segments.tr: Los minoristas sin tienda física han ganado cuota de mercado de manera constante con el tiempo.

segments.src: Their September performance may also reflect the timing of promotional events and early holiday shopping campaigns.
segments.tr: Su desempeño en septiembre también puede reflejar el momento de los eventos promocionales y las campañas de compras navideñas anticipadas.

segments.src: ### 5. Revisions to prior months
segments.tr: ### 5. Revisiones de meses anteriores

segments.src: Previous months' figures are often revised, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: Las cifras de meses anteriores a menudo se revisan, a veces de manera significativa.

segments.src: A revision can change the narrative about the trend just as much as the new monthly number does.
segments.tr: Una revisión puede cambiar la narrativa sobre la tendencia tanto como lo hace la nueva cifra mensual.

segments.src: ## How Households Are Managing
segments.tr: ## Cómo se las arreglan los hogares

segments.src: Several factors help explain why spending has held up for many families, even under pressure:
segments.tr: Varios factores ayudan a explicar por qué el gasto se ha mantenido para muchas familias, incluso bajo presión:

segments.src: - **Employment:** A relatively healthy labor market has supported incomes.
segments.tr: - **Empleo:** Un mercado laboral relativamente saludable ha apoyado los ingresos.

segments.src: - **Savings and credit:** Some households have drawn down savings or relied more on credit to maintain their spending.
segments.tr: - **Ahorros y crédito:** Algunos hogares han reducido sus ahorros o han dependido más del crédito para mantener su gasto.

segments.src: - **Wealth effects:** Gains in home values and financial assets have supported the spending of higher-income households.
segments.tr: - **Efectos de riqueza:** Las ganancias en el valor de las viviendas y los activos financieros han apoyado el gasto de los hogares de mayores ingresos.

segments.src: At the same time, the picture is uneven.
segments.tr: Al mismo tiempo, el panorama es desigual.

segments.src: Lower- and middle-income households tend to be more sensitive to rising costs and borrowing rates, and they are more likely to trade down to cheaper brands or delay purchases.
segments.tr: Los hogares de ingresos bajos y medios tienden a ser más sensibles al aumento de los costos y las tasas de interés, y es más probable que cambien a marcas más baratas o retrasen las compras.

segments.src: Retail executives have increasingly described a more value-conscious shopper.
segments.tr: Los ejecutivos minoristas han descrito cada vez más a un comprador más consciente del valor.

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for the Holiday Quarter
segments.tr: ## Qué podría significar para el trimestre festivo

segments.src: The final three months of the year are the most important period for many retailers, and September data is often read as a preview.
segments.tr: Los últimos tres meses del año son el período más importante para muchos minoristas, y los datos de septiembre a menudo se leen como un adelanto.

segments.src: Retailers typically make inventory, staffing and promotion decisions well in advance, so the latest sales trend influences their expectations.
segments.tr: Los minoristas suelen tomar decisiones de inventario, personal y promoción con mucha antelación, por lo que la última tendencia de ventas influye en sus expectativas.

segments.src: A stronger-than-expected report could suggest that shoppers are still willing to spend, supporting optimistic holiday forecasts.
segments.tr: Un informe más fuerte de lo esperado podría sugerir que los compradores todavía están dispuestos a gastar, apoyando los pronósticos optimistas para las fiestas.

segments.src: A softer report might point to more cautious behavior, potentially leading to heavier discounting and tighter inventory management.
segments.tr: Un informe más débil podría apuntar a un comportamiento más cauteloso, lo que podría conducir a mayores descuentos y una gestión de inventario más estricta.

segments.src: Either way, the details beneath the headline are likely to matter more than a single figure.
segments.tr: De cualquier manera, es probable que los detalles subyacentes a la cifra principal importen más que una sola cifra.

segments.src: ## Policy and Market Implications
segments.tr: ## Implicaciones políticas y de mercado

segments.src: The report also feeds into the broader debate over monetary policy.
segments.tr: El informe también alimenta el debate más amplio sobre la política monetaria.

segments.src: Strong consumer demand can complicate efforts to bring inflation fully back to target, while a clear slowdown may strengthen the case for a more accommodative stance.
segments.tr: La fuerte demanda de los consumidores puede complicar los esfuerzos para devolver la inflación completamente al objetivo, mientras que una desaceleración clara puede fortalecer el caso para una postura más acomodaticia.

segments.src: Financial markets often react quickly to the release, particularly in Treasury yields and in shares of consumer-focused companies.
segments.tr: Los mercados financieros a menudo reaccionan rápidamente a la publicación, particularmente en los rendimientos del Tesoro y en las acciones de empresas centradas en el consumidor.

segments.src: It is worth remembering that a single month of data can be noisy.
segments.tr: Vale la pena recordar que un solo mes de datos puede ser ruidoso.

segments.src: Weather, one-off events and seasonal adjustment issues can all distort the picture, so economists generally prefer to look at multi-month trends.
segments.tr: El clima, los eventos únicos y los problemas de ajuste estacional pueden distorsionar el panorama, por lo que los economistas generalmente prefieren observar las tendencias de varios meses.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: The September retail sales report will not settle every question about the health of the American consumer, but it will provide an important data point at a pivotal moment.
segments.tr: El informe de ventas minoristas de septiembre no resolverá todas las preguntas sobre la salud del consumidor estadounidense, pero proporcionará un punto de datos importante en un momento crucial.

segments.src: ## Why This Report Matters

segments.src: Because it covers so many categories, the report often serves as an early signal for the broader economy.
segments.tr: ولأنه يغطي العديد من الفئات، فإن التقرير غالباً ما يكون بمثابة إشارة مبكرة للاقتصاد الأوسع.

segments.src: A solid reading suggests households still have the capacity and willingness to spend.

segments.src: A weak one can raise questions about whether higher costs are starting to bite.
segments.tr: أما القراءة الضعيفة فقد تثير تساؤلات حول ما إذا كانت التكاليف المرتفعة بدأت تؤثر سلباً.

segments.src: ## The Backdrop: Higher Yields and Persistent Prices
segments.tr: ## الخلفية: ارتفاع العوائد والأسعار المستمرة

segments.src: Two forces are central to this month's story.
segments.tr: هناك قوتان محوريتان في قصة هذا الشهر.

segments.src: First, longer-term Treasury yields have climbed, which tends to push up the interest rates consumers face on mortgages, auto loans and credit cards.
segments.tr: أولاً، ارتفعت عوائد سندات الخزانة طويلة الأجل، مما يميل إلى رفع أسعار الفائدة التي يواجهها المستهلكون على الرهون العقارية وقروض السيارات وبطاقات الائتمان.

segments.src: Higher borrowing costs can discourage big-ticket purchases and make carrying a balance more expensive.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تؤدي تكاليف الاقتراض المرتفعة إلى تثبيط عمليات الشراء الكبيرة وجعل الاحتفاظ برصيد أكثر تكلفة.

segments.src: Second, price pressures have not fully faded.
segments.tr: ثانياً، لم تتلاشَ ضغوط الأسعار تماماً.

segments.src: Even when headline inflation cools, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher prices on essentials such as food, housing and insurance.
segments.tr: حتى عندما يهدأ التضخم الرئيسي، لا تزال العديد من الأسر تشعر بالتأثير التراكمي لارتفاع الأسعار على الضروريات مثل الغذاء والسكن والتأمين.

segments.src: That can leave less room in the budget for discretionary items.
segments.tr: وهذا قد يترك مساحة أقل في الميزانية للسلع الاختيارية.

segments.src: Together, these pressures make the September data a useful test of resilience.
segments.tr: معاً، تجعل هذه الضغوط بيانات سبتمبر اختباراً مفيداً للمرونة.

segments.src: Shoppers have repeatedly surprised forecasters in recent years, but analysts continue to ask how long that can last.
segments.tr: لقد فاجأ المتسوقون المتنبئين مراراً وتكراراً في السنوات الأخيرة، لكن المحللين يواصلون التساؤل إلى متى يمكن أن يستمر ذلك.

segments.src: ## What Analysts Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## ما الذي سيراقبه المحللون

segments.src: Rather than focusing only on the top-line figure, many economists will look at several details in the release.
segments.tr: بدلاً من التركيز فقط على الرقم الرئيسي، سينظر العديد من الاقتصاديين في عدة تفاصيل في الإصدار.

segments.src: ### 1. The headline versus the "control group"
segments.tr: ### 1. الرقم الرئيسي مقابل "مجموعة التحكم"

segments.src: The headline number includes volatile categories such as autos and gasoline.
segments.tr: يتضمن الرقم الرئيسي فئات متقلبة مثل السيارات والبنزين.

segments.src: The so-called control group strips out several of these components and is commonly used as an input for estimates of consumer spending in GDP calculations.
segments.tr: تستبعد ما يسمى بمجموعة التحكم العديد من هذه المكونات وتستخدم عادة كمدخل لتقديرات إنفاق المستهلكين في حسابات الناتج المحلي الإجمالي.

segments.src: A gap between the two can change the interpretation of the report.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تؤدي الفجوة بين الاثنين إلى تغيير تفسير التقرير.

segments.src: ### 2. Nominal versus real spending
segments.tr: ### 2. الإنفاق الاسمي مقابل الإنفاق الحقيقي

segments.src: Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars, so they are not adjusted for price changes.
segments.tr: يتم الإبلاغ عن مبيعات التجزئة بالدولار الاسمي، لذا فهي غير معدلة لتغيرات الأسعار.

segments.src: If prices rose, a modest increase in sales could reflect higher prices rather than more goods purchased.
segments.tr: إذا ارتفعت الأسعار، فقد تعكس الزيادة المتواضعة في المبيعات ارتفاع الأسعار بدلاً من شراء المزيد من السلع.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the data with inflation measures to estimate underlying volume.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يقارن المحللون البيانات بمقاييس التضخم لتقدير الحجم الأساسي.

segments.src: ### 3. Restaurants and services-related spending
segments.tr: ### 3. المطاعم والإنفاق المتعلق بالخدمات

segments.src: Dining out is often viewed as a barometer of discretionary confidence.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يُنظر إلى تناول الطعام في الخارج كمقياس للثقة الاختيارية.

segments.src: Softness at restaurants can suggest households are becoming more selective, while strength can signal that consumers are still prioritizing experiences.
segments.tr: قد يشير الضعف في المطاعم إلى أن الأسر أصبحت أكثر انتقائية، بينما قد تشير القوة إلى أن المستهلكين لا يزالون يعطون الأولوية للتجارب.

segments.src: ### 4. Online versus in-store trends
segments.tr: ### 4. الاتجاهات عبر الإنترنت مقابل المتاجر الفعلية

segments.src: Nonstore retailers have steadily gained share over time.
segments.tr: اكتسب تجار التجزئة غير المعتمدين على المتاجر حصة ثابتة بمرور الوقت.

segments.src: Their September performance may also reflect the timing of promotional events and early holiday shopping campaigns.
segments.tr: قد يعكس أداؤهم في سبتمبر أيضاً توقيت الأحداث الترويجية وحملات التسوق المبكرة للعطلات.

segments.src: ### 5. Revisions to prior months
segments.tr: ### 5. مراجعات الأشهر السابقة

segments.src: Previous months' figures are often revised, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تتم مراجعة أرقام الأشهر السابقة، وأحياناً بشكل ملموس.

segments.src: A revision can change the narrative about the trend just as much as the new monthly number does.
segments.tr: يمكن للمراجعة أن تغير السرد حول الاتجاه تماماً كما يفعل الرقم الشهري الجديد.

segments.src: ## How Households Are Managing
segments.tr: ## كيف تدير الأسر أمورها

segments.src: Several factors help explain why spending has held up for many families, even under pressure:
segments.tr: تساعد عدة عوامل في تفسير سبب صمود الإنفاق بالنسبة للعديد من العائلات، حتى تحت الضغط:

segments.src: - **Employment:** A relatively healthy labor market has supported incomes.
segments.tr: - **التوظيف:** دعم سوق العمل الصحي نسبياً الدخول.

segments.src: - **Savings and credit:** Some households have drawn down savings or relied more on credit to maintain their spending.
segments.tr: - **المدخرات والائتمان:** سحبت بعض الأسر من مدخراتها أو اعتمدت أكثر على الائتمان للحفاظ على إنفاقها.

segments.src: - **Wealth effects:** Gains in home values and financial assets have supported the spending of higher-income households.
segments.tr: - **آثار الثروة:** دعمت المكاسب في قيم المنازل والأصول المالية إنفاق الأسر ذات الدخل المرتفع.

segments.src: At the same time, the picture is uneven.
segments.tr: في الوقت نفسه، الصورة غير متكافئة.

segments.src: Lower- and middle-income households tend to be more sensitive to rising costs and borrowing rates, and they are more likely to trade down to cheaper brands or delay purchases.
segments.tr: تميل الأسر ذات الدخل المنخفض والمتوسط إلى أن تكون أكثر حساسية لارتفاع التكاليف وأسعار الاقتراض، وهي أكثر عرضة للتحول إلى علامات تجارية أرخص أو تأجيل عمليات الشراء.

segments.src: Retail executives have increasingly described a more value-conscious shopper.
segments.tr: وصف مديرو التجزئة بشكل متزايد متسوقاً أكثر وعياً بالقيمة.

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for the Holiday Quarter
segments.tr: ## ماذا يمكن أن يعني ذلك لربع العطلات

segments.src: The final three months of the year are the most important period for many retailers, and September data is often read as a preview.
segments.tr: تعد الأشهر الثلاثة الأخيرة من العام أهم فترة للعديد من تجار التجزئة، وغالباً ما تُقرأ بيانات سبتمبر كمعاينة.

segments.src: Retailers typically make inventory, staffing and promotion decisions well in advance, so the latest sales trend influences their expectations.
segments.tr: عادة ما يتخذ تجار التجزئة قرارات المخزون والتوظيف والترويج مسبقاً، لذا فإن اتجاه المبيعات الأخير يؤثر على توقعاتهم.

segments.src: A stronger-than-expected report could suggest that shoppers are still willing to spend, supporting optimistic holiday forecasts.
segments.tr: قد يشير تقرير أقوى من المتوقع إلى أن المتسوقين لا يزالون راغبين في الإنفاق، مما يدعم توقعات العطلات المتفائلة.

segments.src: A softer report might point to more cautious behavior, potentially leading to heavier discounting and tighter inventory management.
segments.tr: قد يشير تقرير أضعف إلى سلوك أكثر حذراً، مما قد يؤدي إلى خصومات أكبر وإدارة أكثر صرامة للمخزون.

segments.src: Either way, the details beneath the headline are likely to matter more than a single figure.
segments.tr: في كلتا الحالتين، من المرجح أن تكون التفاصيل الموجودة تحت الرقم الرئيسي أكثر أهمية من رقم واحد.

segments.src: ## Policy and Market Implications
segments.tr: ## الآثار السياسية والسوقية

segments.src: The report also feeds into the broader debate over monetary policy.
segments.tr: يغذي التقرير أيضاً النقاش الأوسع حول السياسة النقدية.

segments.src: Strong consumer demand can complicate efforts to bring inflation fully back to target, while a clear slowdown may strengthen the case for a more accommodative stance.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يؤدي طلب المستهلكين القوي إلى تعقيد الجهود الرامية إلى إعادة التضخم بالكامل إلى المستهدف، في حين أن التباطؤ الواضح قد يعزز الحجة لتبني موقف أكثر تيسيراً.

segments.src: Financial markets often react quickly to the release, particularly in Treasury yields and in shares of consumer-focused companies.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تتفاعل الأسواق المالية بسرعة مع الإصدار، خاصة في عوائد سندات الخزانة وأسهم الشركات التي تركز على المستهلك.

segments.src: It is worth remembering that a single month of data can be noisy.
segments.tr: من الجدير بالذكر أن شهراً واحداً من البيانات يمكن أن يكون صاخباً.

segments.src: Weather, one-off events and seasonal adjustment issues can all distort the picture, so economists generally prefer to look at multi-month trends.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تؤدي الأحوال الجوية والأحداث لمرة واحدة وقضايا التعديل الموسمي إلى تشويه الصورة، لذا يفضل الاقتصاديون عموماً النظر إلى الاتجاهات متعددة الأشهر.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The September retail sales report will not settle every question about the health of the American consumer, but it will provide an important data point at a pivotal moment.
segments.tr: لن يحسم تقرير مبيعات التجزئة لشهر سبتمبر كل سؤال حول صحة المستهلك الأمريكي، لكنه سيوفر نقطة بيانات مهمة في لحظة محورية.

segments.src: The key question is whether households are still spending broadly and comfortably, or whether higher borrowing costs and lingering price pressures are forcing more trade-offs.
segments.tr: السؤال الرئيسي هو ما إذا كانت الأسر لا تزال تنفق بشكل واسع ومريح، أو ما إذا كانت تكاليف الاقتراض المرتفعة وضغوط الأسعار المستمرة تجبرهم على المزيد من المقايضات.

segments.src: For readers following the economy, the most useful approach is to watch the control group, compare spending with inflation and consider the data alongside employment and income trends.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للقراء الذين يتابعون الاقتصاد، فإن النهج الأكثر فائدة هو مراقبة مجموعة التحكم، ومقارنة الإنفاق بالتضخم، والنظر في البيانات جنباً إلى جنب مع اتجاهات التوظيف والدخل.

segments.tr: ### 2. Dépenses nominales par rapport aux dépenses réelles

segments.src: Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars, so they are not adjusted for price changes.
segments.tr: Les ventes au détail sont déclarées en dollars nominaux, elles ne sont donc pas ajustées pour les variations de prix.

segments.src: If prices rose, a modest increase in sales could reflect higher prices rather than more goods purchased.
segments.tr: Si les prix ont augmenté, une modeste hausse des ventes pourrait refléter des prix plus élevés plutôt qu'une augmentation des biens achetés.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the data with inflation measures to estimate underlying volume.
segments.tr: Les analystes comparent souvent les données avec les mesures de l'inflation pour estimer le volume sous-jacent.

segments.src: ### 3. Restaurants and services-related spending
segments.tr: ### 3. Les restaurants et les dépenses liées aux services

segments.src: Dining out is often viewed as a barometer of discretionary confidence.
segments.tr: Manger au restaurant est souvent considéré comme un baromètre de la confiance discrétionnaire.

segments.src: Softness at restaurants can suggest households are becoming more selective, while strength can signal that consumers are still prioritizing experiences.
segments.tr: La faiblesse des restaurants peut suggérer que les ménages deviennent plus sélectifs, tandis que la force peut signaler que les consommateurs privilégient toujours les expériences.

segments.src: ### 4. Online versus in-store trends
segments.tr: ### 4. Tendances en ligne par rapport aux tendances en magasin

segments.src: Nonstore retailers have steadily gained share over time.
segments.tr: Les détaillants hors magasin ont régulièrement gagné des parts de marché au fil du temps.

segments.src: Their September performance may also reflect the timing of promotional events and early holiday shopping campaigns.

segments.src: ### 5. Revisions to prior months

segments.src: Previous months' figures are often revised, sometimes meaningfully.

segments.src: A revision can change the narrative about the trend just as much as the new monthly number does.
segments.tr: Une révision peut changer le récit sur la tendance tout autant que le nouveau chiffre mensuel le fait.

segments.src: ## How Households Are Managing
segments.tr: ## Comment les ménages gèrent la situation

segments.src: Several factors help explain why spending has held up for many families, even under pressure:
segments.tr: Plusieurs facteurs aident à expliquer pourquoi les dépenses ont résisté pour de nombreuses familles, même sous pression :

segments.src: - **Employment:** A relatively healthy labor market has supported incomes.
segments.tr: - **Emploi :** Un marché du travail relativement sain a soutenu les revenus.

segments.src: - **Savings and credit:** Some households have drawn down savings or relied more on credit to maintain their spending.
segments.tr: - **Épargne et crédit :** Certains ménages ont puisé dans leur épargne ou ont davantage compté sur le crédit pour maintenir leurs dépenses.

segments.src: - **Wealth effects:** Gains in home values and financial assets have supported the spending of higher-income households.
segments.tr: - **Effets de richesse :** Les gains sur la valeur des logements et les actifs financiers ont soutenu les dépenses des ménages à revenu élevé.

segments.src: At the same time, the picture is uneven.
segments.tr: En même temps, le tableau est inétégral.

segments.src: Lower- and middle-income households tend to be more sensitive to rising costs and borrowing rates, and they are more likely to trade down to cheaper brands or delay purchases.
segments.tr: Les ménages à faible et moyen revenu ont tendance à être plus sensibles à la hausse des coûts et des taux d'emprunt, et ils sont plus susceptibles de se tourner vers des marques moins chères ou de retarder leurs achats.

segments.src: Retail executives have increasingly described a more value-conscious shopper.
segments.tr: Les dirigeants de la vente au détail ont de plus en plus décrit un acheteur plus soucieux de la valeur.

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for the Holiday Quarter
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour le trimestre des fêtes

segments.src: The final three months of the year are the most important period for many retailers, and September data is often read as a preview.
segments.tr: Les trois derniers mois de l'année sont la période la plus importante pour de nombreux détaillants, et les données de septembre sont souvent lues comme un aperçu.

segments.src: Retailers typically make inventory, staffing and promotion decisions well in advance, so the latest sales trend influences their expectations.
segments.tr: Les détaillants prennent généralement leurs décisions en matière d'inventaire, de personnel et de promotion bien à l'avance, de sorte que la dernière tendance des ventes influence leurs attentes.

segments.src: A stronger-than-expected report could suggest that shoppers are still willing to spend, supporting optimistic holiday forecasts.
segments.tr: Un rapport plus fort que prévu pourrait suggérer que les acheteurs sont toujours disposés à dépenser, ce qui soutiendrait des prévisions de fêtes optimistes.

segments.src: A softer report might point to more cautious behavior, potentially leading to heavier discounting and tighter inventory management.
segments.tr: Un rapport plus faible pourrait indiquer un comportement plus prudent, entraînant potentiellement des rabais plus importants et une gestion des stocks plus stricte.

segments.src: Either way, the details beneath the headline are likely to matter more than a single figure.
segments.tr: Dans les deux cas, les détails sous le titre sont susceptibles d'importer plus qu'un chiffre unique.

segments.src: ## Policy and Market Implications
segments.tr: ## Implications pour la politique et le marché

segments.src: The report also feeds into the broader debate over monetary policy.
segments.tr: Le rapport alimente également le débat plus large sur la politique monétaire.

segments.src: Strong consumer demand can complicate efforts to bring inflation fully back to target, while a clear slowdown may strengthen the case for a more accommodative stance.
segments.tr: Une forte demande des consommateurs peut compliquer les efforts pour ramener l'inflation pleinement à la cible, tandis qu'un ralentissement net peut renforcer les arguments en faveur d'une position plus accommodante.

segments.src: Financial markets often react quickly to the release, particularly in Treasury yields and in shares of consumer-focused companies.
segments.tr: Les marchés financiers réagissent souvent rapidement à la publication, en particulier pour les rendements du Trésor et les actions des entreprises axées sur le consommateur.

segments.src: It is worth remembering that a single month of data can be noisy.
segments.tr: Il convient de se rappeler qu'un seul mois de données peut être bruyant.

segments.src: Weather, one-off events and seasonal adjustment issues can all distort the picture, so economists generally prefer to look at multi-month trends.
segments.tr: La météo, les événements ponctuels et les problèmes d'ajustement saisonnier peuvent tous fausser le tableau, de sorte que les économistes préfèrent généralement examiner les tendances sur plusieurs mois.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The September retail sales report will not settle every question about the health of the American consumer, but it will provide an important data point at a pivotal moment.
segments.tr: Le rapport sur les ventes au détail de septembre ne réglera pas toutes les questions concernant la santé du consommateur américain, mais il fournira un point de données important à un moment charnière.

segments.src: The key question is whether households are still spending broadly and comfortably, or whether higher borrowing costs and lingering price pressures are forcing more trade-offs.
segments.tr: La question clé est de savoir si les ménages continuent de dépenser largement et confortablement, ou si des coûts d'emprunt plus élevés et des pressions persistantes sur les prix forcent davantage de compromis.

segments.tr: - Lojas de alimentos e varejistas de mercadorias em geral

segments.tr: - Concessionárias de automóveis e postos de gasolina

segments.src: - Restaurants and bars
segments.tr: - Restaurantes e bares

segments.tr: - Lojas de móveis, eletrônicos e vestuário

segments.src: A solid reading suggests households still have the capacity and willingness to spend.

segments.src: ## The Backdrop: Higher Yields and Persistent Prices
segments.tr: ## O Contexto: Maiores Rendimentos e Preços Persistentes

segments.src: Two forces are central to this month's story.
segments.tr: Duas forças são centrais para a história deste mês.

segments.src: First, longer-term Treasury yields have climbed, which tends to push up the interest rates consumers face on mortgages, auto loans and credit cards.

segments.src: Higher borrowing costs can discourage big-ticket purchases and make carrying a balance more expensive.
segments.tr: Maiores custos de empréstimo podem desestimular compras de alto valor e tornar o carregamento de saldos mais caro.

segments.src: Second, price pressures have not fully faded.
segments.tr: Segundo, as pressões de preços não desapareceram totalmente.

segments.src: Even when headline inflation cools, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher prices on essentials such as food, housing and insurance.
segments.tr: Mesmo quando a inflação principal arrefece, muitas famílias ainda sentem o efeito cumulativo de preços mais altos em itens essenciais, como alimentos, moradia e seguros.

segments.src: That can leave less room in the budget for discretionary items.
segments.tr: Isso pode deixar menos espaço no orçamento para itens discricionários.

segments.src: Together, these pressures make the September data a useful test of resilience.
segments.tr: Juntas, essas pressões tornam os dados de setembro um teste útil de resiliência.

segments.src: Shoppers have repeatedly surprised forecasters in recent years, but analysts continue to ask how long that can last.
segments.tr: Os compradores surpreenderam repetidamente os precursores nos últimos anos, mas os analistas continuam a perguntar por quanto tempo isso pode durar.
