segments.tr: Bahkan ketika inflasi utama mendingin, banyak rumah tangga masih merasakan efek kumulatif dari harga yang lebih tinggi pada kebutuhan pokok seperti makanan, perumahan, dan asuransi.

segments.src: That can leave less room in the budget for discretionary items.
segments.tr: Hal itu dapat menyisakan lebih sedikit ruang dalam anggaran untuk barang-barang non-esensial.

segments.src: Together, these pressures make the September data a useful test of resilience.
segments.tr: Secara bersama-sama, tekanan ini menjadikan data September sebagai ujian ketahanan yang berguna.

segments.src: Shoppers have repeatedly surprised forecasters in recent years, but analysts continue to ask how long that can last.
segments.tr: Pembelanja telah berulang kali mengejutkan para peramal dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, tetapi analis terus bertanya berapa lama hal itu dapat bertahan.

segments.src: ## What Analysts Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## Hal yang Akan Dipantau oleh Analis

segments.src: Rather than focusing only on the top-line figure, many economists will look at several details in the release.
segments.tr: Daripada hanya berfokus pada angka utama, banyak ekonom akan melihat beberapa detail dalam rilis tersebut.

segments.src: ### 1. The headline versus the "control group"
segments.tr: ### 1. Angka utama versus "grup kontrol"

segments.src: The headline number includes volatile categories such as autos and gasoline.
segments.tr: Angka utama mencakup kategori yang mudah berubah seperti mobil dan bensin.

segments.src: The so-called control group strips out several of these components and is commonly used as an input for estimates of consumer spending in GDP calculations.
segments.tr: Yang disebut grup kontrol menghilangkan beberapa komponen ini dan biasanya digunakan sebagai masukan untuk perkiraan pengeluaran konsumen dalam perhitungan PDB.

segments.src: A gap between the two can change the interpretation of the report.
segments.tr: Kesenjangan antara keduanya dapat mengubah interpretasi laporan.

segments.src: ### 2. Nominal versus real spending
segments.tr: ### 2. Pengeluaran nominal versus riil

segments.src: Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars, so they are not adjusted for price changes.
segments.tr: Penjualan ritel dilaporkan dalam dolar nominal, sehingga tidak disesuaikan dengan perubahan harga.

segments.src: If prices rose, a modest increase in sales could reflect higher prices rather than more goods purchased.
segments.tr: Jika harga naik, kenaikan penjualan yang moderat mungkin mencerminkan harga yang lebih tinggi daripada lebih banyaknya barang yang dibeli.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the data with inflation measures to estimate underlying volume.
segments.tr: Analis sering membandingkan data dengan ukuran inflasi untuk memperkirakan volume yang mendasarinya.

segments.src: ### 3. Restaurants and services-related spending
segments.tr: ### 3. Restoran dan pengeluaran terkait layanan

segments.src: Dining out is often viewed as a barometer of discretionary confidence.
segments.tr: Makan di luar sering dipandang sebagai barometer kepercayaan diskresioner.

segments.src: Softness at restaurants can suggest households are becoming more selective, while strength can signal that consumers are still prioritizing experiences.
segments.tr: Kelesuan di restoran dapat mengindikasikan rumah tangga menjadi lebih selektif, sementara kekuatan dapat menandakan bahwa konsumen masih memprioritaskan pengalaman.

segments.src: ### 4. Online versus in-store trends
segments.tr: ### 4. Tren online versus di toko

segments.src: Nonstore retailers have steadily gained share over time.
segments.tr: Peritel non-toko telah terus memperoleh pangsa pasar seiring waktu.

segments.src: Their September performance may also reflect the timing of promotional events and early holiday shopping campaigns.
segments.tr: Kinerja mereka di bulan September juga dapat mencerminkan waktu acara promosi dan kampanye belanja liburan awal.

segments.src: ### 5. Revisions to prior months
segments.tr: ### 5. Revisi pada bulan-bulan sebelumnya

segments.src: Previous months' figures are often revised, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: Angka bulan-bulan sebelumnya sering kali direvisi, terkadang secara signifikan.

segments.src: A revision can change the narrative about the trend just as much as the new monthly number does.
segments.tr: Revisi dapat mengubah narasi tentang tren sama seperti angka bulanan yang baru.

segments.src: ## How Households Are Managing
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Rumah Tangga Mengelolanya

segments.src: Several factors help explain why spending has held up for many families, even under pressure:
segments.tr: Beberapa faktor membantu menjelaskan mengapa pengeluaran tetap bertahan untuk banyak keluarga, bahkan di bawah tekanan:

segments.src: - **Employment:** A relatively healthy labor market has supported incomes.
segments.tr: - **Pekerjaan:** Pasar tenaga kerja yang relatif sehat telah mendukung pendapatan.

segments.src: - **Savings and credit:** Some households have drawn down savings or relied more on credit to maintain their spending.
segments.tr: - **Tabungan dan kredit:** Beberapa rumah tangga telah menguras tabungan atau lebih mengandalkan kredit untuk mempertahankan pengeluaran mereka.

segments.src: - **Wealth effects:** Gains in home values and financial assets have supported the spending of higher-income households.
segments.tr: - **Efek kekayaan:** Kenaikan nilai rumah dan aset keuangan telah mendukung pengeluaran rumah tangga berpendapatan tinggi.

segments.src: At the same time, the picture is uneven.
segments.tr: Pada saat yang sama, gambaran tersebut tidak merata.

segments.src: Lower- and middle-income households tend to be more sensitive to rising costs and borrowing rates, and they are more likely to trade down to cheaper brands or delay purchases.
segments.tr: Rumah tangga berpendapatan rendah dan menengah cenderung lebih sensitif terhadap kenaikan biaya dan suku bunga pinjaman, dan mereka lebih cenderung beralih ke merek yang lebih murah atau menunda pembelian.

segments.src: Retail executives have increasingly described a more value-conscious shopper.
segments.tr: Eksekutif ritel semakin sering menggambarkan pembelanja yang lebih sadar nilai.

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for the Holiday Quarter
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya bagi Kuartal Liburan

segments.src: The final three months of the year are the most important period for many retailers, and September data is often read as a preview.
segments.tr: Tiga bulan terakhir tahun ini adalah periode paling penting bagi banyak peritel, dan data September sering dibaca sebagai pratinjau.

segments.src: Retailers typically make inventory, staffing and promotion decisions well in advance, so the latest sales trend influences their expectations.
segments.tr: Peritel biasanya membuat keputusan inventaris, staf, dan promosi jauh-jauh hari, sehingga tren penjualan terbaru memengaruhi ekspektasi mereka.

segments.src: A stronger-than-expected report could suggest that shoppers are still willing to spend, supporting optimistic holiday forecasts.
segments.tr: Laporan yang lebih kuat dari perkiraan dapat menunjukkan bahwa pembelanja masih bersedia berbelanja, mendukung perkiraan liburan yang optimis.

segments.src: A softer report might point to more cautious behavior, potentially leading to heavier discounting and tighter inventory management.
segments.tr: Laporan yang lebih lemah mungkin mengarah pada perilaku yang lebih hati-hati, yang berpotensi mengarah pada diskon yang lebih berat dan manajemen inventaris yang lebih ketat.

segments.src: Either way, the details beneath the headline are likely to matter more than a single figure.
segments.tr: Bagaimanapun, detail di balik angka utama kemungkinan akan lebih penting daripada satu angka tunggal.

segments.src: ## Policy and Market Implications
segments.tr: ## Implikasi Kebijakan dan Pasar

segments.src: The report also feeds into the broader debate over monetary policy.
segments.tr: Laporan ini juga memicu perdebatan yang lebih luas tentang kebijakan moneter.

segments.src: Strong consumer demand can complicate efforts to bring inflation fully back to target, while a clear slowdown may strengthen the case for a more accommodative stance.
segments.tr: Permintaan konsumen yang kuat dapat mempersulit upaya untuk mengembalikan inflasi sepenuhnya ke target, sementara perlambatan yang jelas dapat memperkuat alasan untuk sikap yang lebih akomodatif.

segments.src: Financial markets often react quickly to the release, particularly in Treasury yields and in shares of consumer-focused companies.
segments.tr: Pasar keuangan sering bereaksi cepat terhadap rilis tersebut, terutama pada imbal hasil Treasury dan saham perusahaan yang berfokus pada konsumen.

segments.src: It is worth remembering that a single month of data can be noisy.
segments.tr: Perlu diingat bahwa satu bulan data bisa jadi bising.

segments.src: Weather, one-off events and seasonal adjustment issues can all distort the picture, so economists generally prefer to look at multi-month trends.
segments.tr: Cuaca, peristiwa satu kali, dan masalah penyesuaian musiman semuanya dapat mendistorsi gambaran tersebut, sehingga para ekonom umumnya lebih suka melihat tren multi-bulan.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The September retail sales report will not settle every question about the health of the American consumer, but it will provide an important data point at a pivotal moment.
segments.tr: Laporan penjualan ritel September tidak akan menyelesaikan setiap pertanyaan tentang kesehatan konsumen Amerika, tetapi laporan ini akan memberikan titik data penting pada saat yang krusial.

segments.src: The key question is whether households are still spending broadly and comfortably, or whether higher borrowing costs and lingering price pressures are forcing more trade-offs.
segments.tr: Pertanyaan utamanya adalah apakah rumah tangga masih berbelanja secara luas dan nyaman, atau apakah biaya pinjaman yang lebih tinggi dan tekanan harga yang tertinggal memaksa lebih banyak kompromi.

segments.src: For readers following the economy, the most useful approach is to watch the control group, compare spending with inflation and consider the data alongside employment and income trends.
segments.tr: Bagi pembaca yang mengikuti ekonomi, pendekatan paling berguna adalah memantau grup kontrol, membandingkan pengeluaran dengan inflasi, dan mempertimbangkan data bersamaan dengan tren pekerjaan dan pendapatan.

ja.title: 今週の小売売上高報告：利回りが上昇する中、アメリカの買い物客は依然として支出を続けているか？

segments.src: This week's September retail sales report is one of the most closely watched economic releases of the fall.
segments.tr: 今週発表される9月の小売売上高報告は、秋の経済発表の中で最も注目されているものの一つである。

segments.src: It offers a direct read on whether American households kept spending in stores, online and at restaurants even as borrowing costs stayed elevated and prices remained stubborn.
segments.tr: 借入コストが高止まりし、物価が根強く推移する中でも、アメリカの家計が店舗、オンライン、レストランでの支出を維持し続けたかどうかについて、直接的な手がかりを提供する。

segments.src: With the holiday quarter approaching, the numbers will shape how analysts, retailers and policymakers think about the strength of the consumer.
segments.tr: ホリデー商戦の四半期を控え、この数値はアナリスト、小売業者、政策立案者が消費者の強さをどのように捉えるかを形作るものとなる。

segments.src: ## Why This Report Matters
segments.tr: ## この報告が重要な理由

segments.src: Consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: 個人消費は米国経済活動の約3分の2を占めており、

segments.src: economic activity, which is why the monthly retail sales release draws so much attention.
segments.tr: それが毎月の小売売上高発表にこれほどの注目が集まる理由である。

segments.src: The report, compiled by the Census Bureau, tracks sales at a broad range of businesses, including:
segments.tr: 国勢調査局によって集計されるこの報告は、以下を含む幅広い企業の売上を追跡している：

segments.src: - Grocery stores and general merchandise retailers
segments.tr: - 食料品店および総合小売業者

segments.src: - Auto dealers and gasoline stations
segments.tr: - 自動車ディーラーおよびガソリンスタンド

segments.src: - Online and other nonstore retailers
segments.tr: - オンラインおよびその他の無店舗小売業者

segments.src: - Restaurants and bars
segments.tr: - レストランおよびバー

segments.src: - Furniture, electronics and clothing stores
segments.tr: - 家具、家電、衣料品店

segments.src: Because it covers so many categories, the report often serves as an early signal for the broader economy.
segments.tr: 非常に多くのカテゴリーをカバーしているため、この報告は広範な経済の早期シグナルとして機能することが多い。

segments.src: A solid reading suggests households still have the capacity and willingness to spend.
segments.tr: 堅調な数値は、家計が依然として支出する能力と意欲を持っていることを示唆する。

segments.src: A weak one can raise questions about whether higher costs are starting to bite.
segments.tr: 弱い数値は、より高いコストが家計を圧迫し始めているかどうかについての疑問を提起する。

segments.src: ## The Backdrop: Higher Yields and Persistent Prices
segments.tr: ## 背景：より高い利回りと持続する物価

segments.src: Two forces are central to this month's story.
segments.tr: 今月の物語の中心にあるのは2つの力である。

segments.src: First, longer-term Treasury yields have climbed, which tends to push up the interest rates consumers face on mortgages, auto loans and credit cards.
segments.tr: 第一に、長期の財務省証券（国債）利回りが上昇しており、これが消費者が住宅ローン、自動車ローン、クレジットカードで直面する金利を押し上げる傾向がある。

segments.src: Higher borrowing costs can discourage big-ticket purchases and make carrying a balance more expensive.
segments.tr: 借入コストの上昇は、高額商品の購入を思いとどまらせ、残高を維持するコストを高める可能性がある。

segments.src: Second, price pressures have not fully faded.
segments.tr: 第二に、物価上昇圧力が完全に薄れていないことである。

segments.src: Even when headline inflation cools, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher prices on essentials such as food, housing and insurance.
segments.tr: ヘッドラインのインフレ率が鈍化しても、多くの家計は食料、住居、保険などの必需品に対する物価上昇の累積的な影響を依然として感じている。

segments.src: That can leave less room in the budget for discretionary items.
segments.tr: それは、裁量的な支出のための予算の余地を狭める可能性がある。

segments.src: Together, these pressures make the September data a useful test of resilience.
segments.tr: 合わせて、これらの圧力は9月のデータを回復力の有用なテストにする。

segments.src: Shoppers have repeatedly surprised forecasters in recent years, but analysts continue to ask how long that can last.
segments.tr: 買い物客は近年、予想を繰り返し驚かせてきたが、アナリストらはそれがいつまで続くのか問い続けている。

segments.tr: ヘッドラインの数値には、自動車やガソリンなどのボラティリティの高いカテゴリーが含まれている。

segments.src: The so-called control group strips out several of these components and is commonly used as an input for estimates of consumer spending in GDP calculations.
segments.tr: いわゆるコントロールグループは、これらの成分のいくつかを除外し、GDP計算における個人消費の推計のための入力として一般的に使用される。

segments.tr: アナリストは、基礎となる数量を推計するために、データをインフレ指標と比較することが多い。

segments.tr: 外食は、裁量的な信頼感のバロメーターと見なされることが多い。

segments.src: Softness at restaurants can suggest households are becoming more selective, while strength can signal that consumers are still prioritizing experiences.
segments.tr: レストランでの軟調さは家計がより選択的になっていることを示唆し、強さは消費者が依然として経験を優先していることを示す可能性がある。

segments.src: ## How Households Are Managing

segments.tr: いくつかの要因が、プレッシャーの下でも多くの家族にとって支出が持ちこたえている理由を説明するのに役立っている：

segments.src: ## Policy and Market Implications
segments.tr: ## 政策と市場への影響

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

de.title: Einzelhandelsumsatzbericht dieser Woche: Gibt der amerikanische Verbraucher bei steigenden Renditen immer noch Geld aus?

segments.src: This week's September retail sales report is one of the most closely watched economic releases of the fall.
segments.tr: Der Einzelhandelsumsatzbericht für September ist diese Woche eine der am aufmerksamsten beobachteten wirtschaftlichen Veröffentlichungen des Herbstes.

segments.src: It offers a direct read on whether American households kept spending in stores, online and at restaurants even as borrowing costs stayed elevated and prices remained stubborn.
segments.tr: Er bietet einen direkten Aufschluss darüber, ob amerikanische Haushalte weiterhin in Geschäften, online und in Restaurants Geld ausgeben, selbst wenn die Kreditkosten hoch bleiben und die Preise hartnäckig sind.

segments.src: With the holiday quarter approaching, the numbers will shape how analysts, retailers and policymakers think about the strength of the consumer.
segments.tr: Da das Feiertagsquartal näher rückt, werden die Zahlen beeinflussen, wie Analysten, Einzelhändler und politische Entscheidungsträger die Stärke der Verbraucher einschätzen.

segments.src: ## Why This Report Matters
segments.tr: ## Warum dieser Bericht wichtig ist

segments.src: Consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: Die Verbraucherausgaben machen etwa zwei Drittel der US-Wirtschaftsaktivität aus,

segments.src: economic activity, which is why the monthly retail sales release draws so much attention.
segments.tr: weshalb die monatliche Veröffentlichung der Einzelhandelsumsätze so viel Aufmerksamkeit auf sich zieht.

segments.src: The report, compiled by the Census Bureau, tracks sales at a broad range of businesses, including:
segments.tr: Der Bericht, der vom Census Bureau zusammengestellt wird, verfolgt die Umsätze bei einer breiten Palette von Unternehmen, darunter:

segments.src: - Grocery stores and general merchandise retailers
segments.tr: - Lebensmittelgeschäfte und allgemeine Einzelhändler

segments.src: - Auto dealers and gasoline stations
segments.tr: - Autohändler und Tankstellen

segments.src: - Online and other nonstore retailers
segments.tr: - Online- und andere Einzelhändler ohne Ladengeschäft

segments.src: - Restaurants and bars
segments.tr: - Restaurants und Bars

segments.src: - Furniture, electronics and clothing stores
segments.tr: - Möbel-, Elektronik- und Bekleidungsgeschäfte

segments.src: Because it covers so many categories, the report often serves as an early signal for the broader economy.
segments.tr: Da er so viele Kategorien abdeckt, dient der Bericht oft als Frühindikator für die Gesamtwirtschaft.

segments.src: A solid reading suggests households still have the capacity and willingness to spend.
segments.tr: Ein solider Wert deutet darauf hin, dass die Haushalte immer noch die Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft haben, Geld auszugeben.

segments.src: A weak one can raise questions about whether higher costs are starting to bite.
segments.tr: Ein schwacher Wert kann Fragen darüber aufwerfen, ob die höheren Kosten allmählich spürbar werden.

segments.src: ## The Backdrop: Higher Yields and Persistent Prices
segments.tr: ## Der Hintergrund: Höhere Renditen und anhaltende Preise

segments.src: Two forces are central to this month's story.
segments.tr: Zwei Kräfte stehen im Mittelpunkt der Geschichte dieses Monats.

segments.src: First, longer-term Treasury yields have climbed, which tends to push up the interest rates consumers face on mortgages, auto loans and credit cards.
segments.tr: Erstens sind die längerfristigen Treasury-Renditen gestiegen, was tendenziell die Zinssätze erhöht, mit denen Verbraucher bei Hypotheken, Autokrediten und Kreditkarten konfrontiert sind.

segments.src: Higher borrowing costs can discourage big-ticket purchases and make carrying a balance more expensive.
segments.tr: Höhere Kreditkosten können von größeren Anschaffungen abhalten und das Halten eines Saldos teurer machen.

segments.src: Second, price pressures have not fully faded.
segments.tr: Zweitens sind die Preisdruckfaktoren nicht vollständig abgeklungen.

segments.src: Even when headline inflation cools, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher prices on essentials such as food, housing and insurance.
segments.tr: Selbst wenn sich die Gesamtinflation abkühlt, spüren viele Haushalte immer noch die kumulativen Auswirkungen höherer Preise für lebensnotwendige Güter wie Lebensmittel, Wohnen und Versicherungen.

segments.src: That can leave less room in the budget for discretionary items.
segments.tr: Das kann weniger Spielraum im Budget für diskretionäre Ausgaben lassen.

segments.src: Together, these pressures make the September data a useful test of resilience.
segments.tr: Zusammengenommen machen diese Belastungen die September-Daten zu einem nützlichen Test der Widerstandsfähigkeit.

segments.src: Shoppers have repeatedly surprised forecasters in recent years, but analysts continue to ask how long that can last.
segments.tr: Die Käufer haben die Prognostiker in den letzten Jahren wiederholt überrascht, aber Analysten fragen weiterhin, wie lange das anhalten kann.

segments.src: ## What Analysts Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## Worauf Analysten achten werden

segments.src: Rather than focusing only on the top-line figure, many economists will look at several details in the release.
segments.tr: Anstatt sich nur auf die Gesamtzahl zu konzentrieren, werden viele Ökonomen auf mehrere Details in der Veröffentlichung achten.

segments.src: ### 1. The headline versus the "control group"
segments.tr: ### 1. Die Schlagzeile gegenüber der "Kontrollgruppe"

segments.src: The headline number includes volatile categories such as autos and gasoline.
segments.tr: Die Schlagzeilenzahl enthält volatile Kategorien wie Autos und Benzin.

segments.src: The so-called control group strips out several of these components and is commonly used as an input for estimates of consumer spending in GDP calculations.
segments.tr: Die sogenannte Kontrollgruppe schließt mehrere dieser Komponenten aus und wird häufig als Input für Schätzungen der Verbraucherausgaben in BIP-Berechnungen verwendet.

segments.src: A gap between the two can change the interpretation of the report.
segments.tr: Eine Lücke zwischen beiden kann die Interpretation des Berichts verändern.

segments.src: ### 2. Nominal versus real spending
segments.tr: ### 2. Nominale gegenüber realen Ausgaben

segments.src: Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars, so they are not adjusted for price changes.
segments.tr: Einzelhandelsumsätze werden in nominalen Dollar gemeldet, daher sind sie nicht an Preisänderungen angepasst.

segments.src: If prices rose, a modest increase in sales could reflect higher prices rather than more goods purchased.
segments.tr: Wenn die Preise gestiegen sind, könnte ein moderater Anstieg der Umsätze eher höhere Preise als mehr gekaufte Waren widerspiegeln.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the data with inflation measures to estimate underlying volume.
segments.tr: Analysten vergleichen die Daten oft mit Inflationsmaßen, um das zugrunde liegende Volumen zu schätzen.

segments.src: ### 3. Restaurants and services-related spending
segments.tr: ### 3. Restaurants und dienstleistungsbezogene Ausgaben

segments.src: Dining out is often viewed as a barometer of discretionary confidence.
segments.tr: Auswärts essen wird oft als Barometer für das diskretionäre Vertrauen angesehen.

segments.src: Softness at restaurants can suggest households are becoming more selective, while strength can signal that consumers are still prioritizing experiences.
segments.tr: Schwäche in Restaurants kann darauf hindeuten, dass Haushalte wählerischer werden, während Stärke signalisieren kann, dass Verbraucher weiterhin Erlebnisse priorisieren.

segments.src: ### 4. Online versus in-store trends
segments.tr: ### 4. Online- gegenüber stationären Trends

segments.src: Nonstore retailers have steadily gained share over time.
segments.tr: Einzelhändler ohne Ladengeschäft haben im Laufe der Zeit stetig an Anteil gewonnen.

segments.src: Their September performance may also reflect the timing of promotional events and early holiday shopping campaigns.
segments.tr: Ihre Performance im September könnte auch den Zeitpunkt von Werbeaktionen und frühen Feiertagseinkaufskampagnen widerspiegeln.

segments.src: ### 5. Revisions to prior months
segments.tr: ### 5. Revisionen für Vormonate

segments.src: Previous months' figures are often revised, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: Die Zahlen der Vormonate werden oft revidiert, manchmal bedeutsam.

segments.src: A revision can change the narrative about the trend just as much as the new monthly number does.
segments.tr: Eine Revision kann das Narrativ über den Trend genauso stark verändern wie die neue monatliche Zahl.

segments.src: ## How Households Are Managing
segments.tr: ## Wie Haushalte zurechtkommen

segments.src: Several factors help explain why spending has held up for many families, even under pressure:
segments.tr: Mehrere Faktoren helfen zu erklären, warum die Ausgaben für viele Familien auch unter Druck stabil geblieben sind:

segments.src: - **Employment:** A relatively healthy labor market has supported incomes.
segments.tr: - **Beschäftigung:** Ein relativ gesunder Arbeitsmarkt hat die Einkommen gestützt.

segments.src: - **Savings and credit:** Some households have drawn down savings or relied more on credit to maintain their spending.
segments.tr: - **Ersparnisse und Kredite:** Einige Haushalte haben Ersparnisse aufgebraucht oder sich stärker auf Kredite verlassen, um ihre Ausgaben aufrechtzuerhalten.

segments.src: - **Wealth effects:** Gains in home values and financial assets have supported the spending of higher-income households.
segments.tr: - **Vermögenseffekte:** Gewinne bei Immobilienwerten und Finanzanlagen haben die Ausgaben einkommensstärkerer Haushalte gestützt.

segments.src: At the same time, the picture is uneven.
segments.tr: Gleichzeitig ist das Bild ungleichmäßig.

segments.src: Lower- and middle-income households tend to be more sensitive to rising costs and borrowing rates, and they are more likely to trade down to cheaper brands or delay purchases.
segments.tr: Haushalte mit niedrigem und mittlerem Einkommen reagieren tendenziell empfindlicher auf steigende Kosten und Kreditzinsen und wechseln eher zu billigeren Marken oder schieben Anschaffungen auf.

segments.src: Retail executives have increasingly described a more value-conscious shopper.
segments.tr: Einzelhandelsmanager haben zunehmend einen preisbewussteren Käufer beschrieben.

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for the Holiday Quarter
segments.tr: ## Was das für das Feiertagsquartal bedeuten könnte

segments.src: The final three months of the year are the most important period for many retailers, and September data is often read as a preview.
segments.tr: Die letzten drei Monate des Jahres sind für viele Einzelhändler der wichtigste Zeitraum, und die September-Daten werden oft als Vorschau gelesen.

segments.src: Retailers typically make inventory, staffing and promotion decisions well in advance, so the latest sales trend influences their expectations.
segments.tr: Einzelhändler treffen typischerweise Entscheidungen zu Lagerbeständen, Personal und Werbung weit im Voraus, daher beeinflusst der neueste Umsatztrend ihre Erwartungen.

segments.src: A stronger-than-expected report could suggest that shoppers are still willing to spend, supporting optimistic holiday forecasts.
segments.tr: Ein stärker als erwarteter Bericht könnte darauf hindeuten, dass Käufer immer noch bereit sind, Geld auszugeben, was optimistische Feiertagsprognosen stützt.

segments.src: A softer report might point to more cautious behavior, potentially leading to heavier discounting and tighter inventory management.
segments.tr: Ein schwächerer Bericht könnte auf vorsichtigeres Verhalten hinweisen, was potenziell zu stärkeren Rabatten und einem strafferen Bestandsmanagement führen könnte.

segments.src: Either way, the details beneath the headline are likely to matter more than a single figure.
segments.tr: So oder so dürften die Details unter der Schlagzeile wichtiger sein als eine einzelne Zahl.

segments.src: ## Policy and Market Implications
segments.tr: ## Politische und marktbezogene Auswirkungen

segments.src: The report also feeds into the broader debate over monetary policy.
segments.tr: Der Bericht fließt auch in die breitere Debatte über die Geldpolitik ein.

segments.src: Strong consumer demand can complicate efforts to bring inflation fully back to target, while a clear slowdown may strengthen the case for a more accommodative stance.
segments.tr: Eine starke Verbrauchernachfrage kann Bemühungen erschweren, die Inflation vollständig auf das Ziel zurückzubringen, während eine deutliche Verlangsamung das Argument für eine akkommodierendere Haltung stärken könnte.

segments.src: Financial markets often react quickly to the release, particularly in Treasury yields and in shares of consumer-focused companies.
segments.tr: Finanzmärkte reagieren oft schnell auf die Veröffentlichung, insbesondere bei Treasury-Renditen und bei Aktien von verbraucherorientierten Unternehmen.

segments.src: It is worth remembering that a single month of data can be noisy.
segments.tr: Es ist erwähnenswert, dass ein einzelner Monat an Daten verrauscht sein kann.

segments.src: Weather, one-off events and seasonal adjustment issues can all distort the picture, so economists generally prefer to look at multi-month trends.
segments.tr: Wetter, einmalige Ereignisse und Probleme bei der Saisonbereinigung können das Bild verzerren, daher bevorzugen Ökonomen im Allgemeinen die Betrachtung von Mehrmonatstrends.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The September retail sales report will not settle every question about the health of the American consumer, but it will provide an important data point at a pivotal moment.
segments.tr: Der Einzelhandelsumsatzbericht für September wird nicht jede Frage zur Gesundheit des amerikanischen Verbrauchers klären, aber er wird einen wichtigen Datenpunkt in einem entscheidenden Moment liefern.

segments.src: The key question is whether households are still spending broadly and comfortably, or whether higher borrowing costs and lingering price pressures are forcing more trade-offs.
segments.tr: Die Schlüsselfrage ist, ob Haushalte immer noch breit und komfortabel Geld ausgeben oder ob höhere Kreditkosten und anhaltender Preisdruck zu mehr Kompromissen zwingen.

segments.src: For readers following the economy, the most useful approach is to watch the control group, compare spending with inflation and consider the data alongside employment and income trends.
segments.tr: Für Leser, die die Wirtschaft verfolgen, ist der nützlichste Ansatz, die Kontrollgruppe zu beobachten, die Ausgaben mit der Inflation zu vergleichen und die Daten neben Beschäftigungs- und Einkommenstrends zu betrachten.

segments.src: Dining out is often viewed as a barometer of discretionary confidence.
segments.tr: Ăn uống bên ngoài thường được xem là thước đo niềm tin vào chi tiêu không thiết yếu.

segments.src: Softness at restaurants can suggest households are becoming more selective, while strength can signal that consumers are still prioritizing experiences.
segments.tr: Sự yếu kém tại các nhà hàng có thể cho thấy các hộ gia đình đang trở nên chọn lọc hơn, trong khi sự mạnh mẽ có thể báo hiệu rằng người tiêu dùng vẫn đang ưu tiên các trải nghiệm.

segments.src: ### 4. Online versus in-store trends
segments.tr: ### 4. Xu hướng trực tuyến so với tại cửa hàng

segments.src: Nonstore retailers have steadily gained share over time.
segments.tr: Các nhà bán lẻ không phải cửa hàng đã dần dần giành được thị phần theo thời gian.

segments.src: Their September performance may also reflect the timing of promotional events and early holiday shopping campaigns.
segments.tr: Hiệu suất tháng 9 của họ cũng có thể phản ánh thời điểm của các sự kiện khuyến mãi và các chiến dịch mua sắm lễ hội sớm.

segments.src: ### 5. Revisions to prior months
segments.tr: ### 5. Điều chỉnh cho các tháng trước

segments.src: Previous months' figures are often revised, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: Các số liệu của những tháng trước thường được điều chỉnh, đôi khi một cách đáng kể.

segments.src: A revision can change the narrative about the trend just as much as the new monthly number does.
segments.tr: Một sự điều chỉnh có thể thay đổi câu chuyện về xu hướng nhiều như con số hàng tháng mới.

segments.src: ## How Households Are Managing
segments.tr: ## Các hộ gia đình đang xoay xở như thế nào

segments.src: Several factors help explain why spending has held up for many families, even under pressure:
segments.tr: Một số yếu tố giúp giải thích tại sao chi tiêu vẫn được duy trì đối với nhiều gia đình, ngay cả khi chịu áp lực:

segments.src: - **Employment:** A relatively healthy labor market has supported incomes.
segments.tr: - **Việc làm:** Thị trường lao động tương đối lành mạnh đã hỗ trợ thu nhập.

segments.src: - **Savings and credit:** Some households have drawn down savings or relied more on credit to maintain their spending.
segments.tr: - **Tiết kiệm và tín dụng:** Một số hộ gia đình đã rút tiền tiết kiệm hoặc dựa nhiều hơn vào tín dụng để duy trì chi tiêu.

segments.src: - **Wealth effects:** Gains in home values and financial assets have supported the spending of higher-income households.
segments.tr: - **Hiệu ứng tài sản:** Sự gia tăng giá trị nhà ở và tài sản tài chính đã hỗ trợ chi tiêu của các hộ gia đình có thu nhập cao hơn.

segments.src: At the same time, the picture is uneven.
segments.tr: Đồng thời, bức tranh không đồng đều.

segments.src: Lower- and middle-income households tend to be more sensitive to rising costs and borrowing rates, and they are more likely to trade down to cheaper brands or delay purchases.
segments.tr: Các hộ gia đình có thu nhập thấp và trung bình có xu hướng nhạy cảm hơn với chi phí và lãi suất vay tăng cao, và họ có nhiều khả năng chuyển sang các thương hiệu rẻ hơn hoặc trì hoãn việc mua sắm.

segments.src: Retail executives have increasingly described a more value-conscious shopper.
segments.tr: Các giám đốc điều hành bán lẻ ngày càng mô tả một người mua sắm chú trọng đến giá trị hơn.

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for the Holiday Quarter
segments.tr: ## Điều đó có thể có ý nghĩa gì đối với quý lễ hội

segments.src: The final three months of the year are the most important period for many retailers, and September data is often read as a preview.
segments.tr: Ba tháng cuối năm là giai đoạn quan trọng nhất đối với nhiều nhà bán lẻ, và dữ liệu tháng 9 thường được đọc như một bản xem trước.

segments.src: Retailers typically make inventory, staffing and promotion decisions well in advance, so the latest sales trend influences their expectations.
segments.tr: Các nhà bán lẻ thường đưa ra các quyết định về hàng tồn kho, nhân sự và khuyến mãi từ trước, vì vậy xu hướng doanh số mới nhất ảnh hưởng đến kỳ vọng của họ.

segments.src: A stronger-than-expected report could suggest that shoppers are still willing to spend, supporting optimistic holiday forecasts.
segments.tr: Một báo cáo mạnh hơn dự kiến có thể cho thấy người mua sắm vẫn sẵn sàng chi tiêu, hỗ trợ các dự báo lạc quan cho kỳ nghỉ lễ.

segments.src: A softer report might point to more cautious behavior, potentially leading to heavier discounting and tighter inventory management.
segments.tr: Một báo cáo yếu hơn có thể chỉ ra hành vi thận trọng hơn, có khả năng dẫn đến việc giảm giá mạnh hơn và quản lý hàng tồn kho chặt chẽ hơn.

segments.src: Either way, the details beneath the headline are likely to matter more than a single figure.
segments.tr: Dù thế nào đi nữa, các chi tiết bên dưới con số tiêu đề có khả năng quan trọng hơn một con số đơn lẻ.

segments.src: ## Policy and Market Implications
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa đối với chính sách và thị trường

segments.src: The report also feeds into the broader debate over monetary policy.
segments.tr: Báo cáo cũng góp phần vào cuộc tranh luận rộng lớn hơn về chính sách tiền tệ.

segments.src: Strong consumer demand can complicate efforts to bring inflation fully back to target, while a clear slowdown may strengthen the case for a more accommodative stance.
segments.tr: Nhu cầu tiêu dùng mạnh mẽ có thể làm phức tạp các nỗ lực đưa lạm phát trở lại mục tiêu hoàn toàn, trong khi sự chậm lại rõ ràng có thể củng cố lập luận cho một lập trường nới lỏng hơn.

segments.src: Financial markets often react quickly to the release, particularly in Treasury yields and in shares of consumer-focused companies.
segments.tr: Thị trường tài chính thường phản ứng nhanh với báo cáo, đặc biệt là lợi suất trái phiếu kho bạc và cổ phiếu của các công ty tập trung vào người tiêu dùng.

segments.src: It is worth remembering that a single month of data can be noisy.
segments.tr: Cần nhớ rằng dữ liệu của một tháng đơn lẻ có thể gây nhiễu.

segments.src: Weather, one-off events and seasonal adjustment issues can all distort the picture, so economists generally prefer to look at multi-month trends.
segments.tr: Thời tiết, các sự kiện bất thường và các vấn đề điều chỉnh theo mùa đều có thể làm sai lệch bức tranh, vì vậy các nhà kinh tế thường thích xem xét các xu hướng kéo dài nhiều tháng.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The September retail sales report will not settle every question about the health of the American consumer, but it will provide an important data point at a pivotal moment.
segments.tr: Báo cáo doanh số bán lẻ tháng 9 sẽ không giải quyết mọi câu hỏi về sức khỏe của người tiêu dùng Mỹ, nhưng nó sẽ cung cấp một điểm dữ liệu quan trọng tại một thời điểm then chốt.

segments.src: The key question is whether households are still spending broadly and comfortably, or whether higher borrowing costs and lingering price pressures are forcing more trade-offs.
segments.tr: Câu hỏi chính là liệu các hộ gia đình có còn chi tiêu rộng rãi và thoải mái hay không, hay chi phí vay cao hơn và áp lực giá cả dai dẳng đang buộc họ phải đánh đổi nhiều hơn.

segments.src: For readers following the economy, the most useful approach is to watch the control group, compare spending with inflation and consider the data alongside employment and income trends.
segments.tr: Đối với độc giả theo dõi nền kinh tế, cách tiếp cận hữu ích nhất là theo dõi nhóm kiểm soát, so sánh chi tiêu với lạm phát và xem xét dữ liệu cùng với các xu hướng việc làm và thu nhập.
